zh: 终端里输入框为空时连按两下 Esc，打开回退菜单，回到之前任意一条消息改了重来。
en: In the terminal, press Esc twice on an empty prompt to open the rewind menu and redo from any earlier message.

zh: 终端里按 Shift+Tab 轮换权限模式：Manual、自动接受编辑、计划模式，还有 auto。
en: In the terminal, Shift+Tab cycles permission modes: Manual, accept edits, plan mode, and auto.

zh: CLAUDE.md 是项目的长期记忆，每次启动都会读。不知道怎么写？跑一下 /init 让它自己生成。
en: CLAUDE.md is the project memory, read on every start. Run /init to have Claude draft one for you.

zh: 终端里以 ! 开头直接跑 shell 命令，命令和输出都进对话，Claude 还会顺手解读结果。
en: In the terminal, start a prompt with ! to run a shell command. Command and output land in the chat, and Claude reacts to it.

zh: 输入 @ 加文件名，把文件直接带进对话，不用让 Claude 再去找。
en: Type @ plus a file name to pull that file straight into the conversation.

zh: 命令行里 claude -p "问题" 是无头模式：不进交互界面，答完就退出，适合塞进脚本和 CI。
en: On the command line, claude -p "question" runs headless: no UI, answers and exits. Great for scripts and CI.

zh: 命令行里 claude -c 接着上一次的会话聊；claude --resume 可以从历史会话里挑一个继续。
en: On the command line, claude -c continues your last session; claude --resume lets you pick any past one.

zh: /compact 把前面的对话压缩成摘要腾出上下文，后面可以跟一句话告诉它重点保留什么。
en: /compact summarizes the conversation to free context. Add a note to say what to keep.

zh: 子 agent 有独立的上下文窗口。派它去翻代码，翻过的几十个文件不会塞满主对话。
en: Subagents get their own context window, so the dozens of files they read stay out of yours.

zh: Hooks 能在固定时机自动跑命令，比如每次改完文件就跑格式化，不用每次提醒 Claude。
en: Hooks run commands at fixed moments, like formatting after every edit, so you never have to ask.

zh: Skill 平时只露出简介，用得上时才读全文，所以装很多也不占上下文。
en: Skills show only their description until needed, so installing many barely costs context.

zh: MCP 是 Anthropic 2024 年 11 月开源的协议，一年后捐给了 Linux 基金会，不再由一家公司掌管。
en: Anthropic open-sourced MCP in November 2024. A year later it donated it to the Linux Foundation, so no single company runs it.

zh: Claude Code 2025 年 2 月和 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 一起首发。内部原来叫 Claude CLI，发布前才改名。
en: Claude Code debuted in February 2025 alongside Claude 3.7 Sonnet. Internally it was Claude CLI until just before launch.

zh: 你正在玩的蹦一蹦就是一个 Mod：挂在 Claude Code 的事件上，自己画面板、自己算动画。
en: This game is a Mod: it hooks into Claude Code events, draws its own pane and animates itself.

zh: 终端里按 Ctrl+G，把正在写的 prompt 或 Claude 给的计划丢进默认编辑器里改，长需求舒服多了。
en: In the terminal, Ctrl+G opens your prompt, or Claude's proposed plan, in your default editor. Long asks get much easier.

zh: 终端里 Ctrl+S 先把写了一半的输入存起来，空输入框再按一次就原样恢复。
en: In the terminal, Ctrl+S stashes a half-written prompt. Press it again on an empty prompt to get it back.

zh: 终端里 Ctrl+B 把正在跑的命令或子 agent 挪到后台，你接着聊。tmux 里要按两下。
en: In the terminal, Ctrl+B sends a running command or subagent to the background so you can keep chatting. Press twice in tmux.

zh: Ctrl+O 看完整过程：终端里打开记录视图，桌面端轮换详略模式，每次工具调用的细节都在。
en: Ctrl+O shows the full story: the transcript viewer in the terminal, or cycling detail levels on desktop. Every tool call is there.

zh: 终端里截图直接 Ctrl+V 粘进来（iTerm2 用 Cmd+V），输入框会出现 [Image #1] 这样的标记。
en: In the terminal, paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V (Cmd+V in iTerm2). An [Image #1] chip shows up in your prompt.

zh: 终端里 Ctrl+R 反向搜索以前写过的 prompt，默认把所有项目的历史都翻一遍。
en: In the terminal, Ctrl+R searches your past prompts, across all projects by default.

zh: 桌面端 Cmd+Shift+I 打开模型菜单，Cmd+Shift+E 调思考力度，Windows 把 Cmd 换成 Ctrl。
en: On desktop, Cmd+Shift+I opens the model menu and Cmd+Shift+E the effort menu. Use Ctrl on Windows.

zh: 终端里想换行？Ctrl+J 在任何终端都能用，不用配置；输入 \ 再回车也行。
en: Need a newline in the terminal? Ctrl+J works everywhere with no setup. Typing \ then Enter works too.

zh: 记不住快捷键？终端里在空输入框按 ?，桌面端按 Cmd+/（Windows 用 Ctrl+/），速查表就出来了。
en: Forgot a shortcut? Press ? on an empty prompt in the terminal, or Cmd+/ on desktop (Ctrl+/ on Windows).

zh: 终端里 Ctrl+W 往回删到上一个空格，一下删掉整条路径；删错了 Ctrl+Y 贴回来。
en: In the terminal, Ctrl+W deletes back to the last space, a whole path in one go. Ctrl+Y pastes it back.

zh: Claude 干活时照样可以打字回车，消息会排队，等手头这批工具调用结束就送进同一轮。
en: You can type and hit Enter while Claude works. Your message queues and joins the same turn once the current tool calls finish.

zh: 终端里排队的消息想反悔？在输入框第一行按上箭头，就能把它们拿回来改。
en: Changed your mind about a queued message? In the terminal, press Up on the first line of the prompt to pull it back.

zh: 按 Esc 打断 Claude，已经做完的活会保留，你直接改方向就行。
en: Esc stops Claude mid-turn but keeps the work done so far, so you can redirect right away.

zh: 终端里的 vim 党：在 /config 打开 vim 模式，还能用 vimInsertModeRemaps 把 jj 映射成 Esc。
en: Vim fans in the terminal: turn on vim mode in /config, then use vimInsertModeRemaps to map jj to Esc.

zh: 终端里刚打开会话时输入框那条灰色示例，是照着你项目最近的 git 历史挑的。
en: That gray example in the terminal prompt when a session opens? It's picked from your project's recent git history.

zh: 终端里粘贴的文字若带看不见的 Unicode 字符（零宽、方向控制），发送前会被删掉，防有人藏指令。
en: In the terminal, invisible Unicode in pasted text, like zero-width or bidi marks, is stripped before sending so no one hides instructions.

zh: /btw 问个旁支问题，答案不进对话历史，Claude 干活时也能问。桌面端按 Cmd+; 也行。
en: /btw asks a side question that stays out of the history, even while Claude works. On desktop, Cmd+; does it too.

zh: 终端里 /branch 在当前位置给对话开个分支去试别的方向，原对话还在，/resume 能回去。
en: In the terminal, /branch forks the conversation here so you can try another direction. The original stays; /resume gets you back.

zh: 终端里跑 /context，用彩色格子看上下文被谁占了。Claude 不听 CLAUDE.md？先看它到底加载没。
en: In the terminal, /context draws what fills your context as a colored grid. Claude ignoring CLAUDE.md? Check it even loaded.

zh: /insights 分析你本机最近的会话，生成一份 HTML 报告：常干什么、哪里容易翻车、该试哪些功能。
en: /insights builds an HTML report on your recent sessions: what you work on, where things go wrong, what to try.

zh: /security-review 把当前分支相对主分支的改动过一遍安全审查：注入、鉴权、数据泄露。
en: /security-review checks your branch's diff against the default branch for injection, auth and data-exposure risks.

zh: 终端里 /statusline 不带参数运行，它会照着你 shell 提示符的样子自动配好状态栏。
en: In the terminal, run /statusline with no arguments and it builds a status line that matches your shell prompt.

zh: 终端里 /add-dir 给本次会话多加一个能读写的目录，跨仓库改东西时很好用。
en: In the terminal, /add-dir gives this session access to another directory. Handy for cross-repo changes.

zh: /import 能把 Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor 的指令文件、MCP、子 agent 等配置一键搬过来。
en: /import brings instruction files, MCP servers, subagents and skills over from Codex, Gemini CLI or Cursor.

zh: 输入 /stickers，是真的可以下单 Claude Code 贴纸。
en: /stickers really does let you order Claude Code stickers.

zh: /radio 会在浏览器里打开 Claude FM，一个低保真音乐电台，写代码时听。
en: /radio opens Claude FM, a lo-fi radio stream, in your browser. Coding music, built in.

zh: /simplify 派 4 个审查 agent 并行看你的改动：能否复用、能否简化、效率等，然后直接改好。
en: /simplify runs four review agents in parallel (reuse, simplification, efficiency and more), then applies the fixes.

zh: /batch 把大规模改动拆成 5 到 30 个独立单元，每个交给一个在独立 worktree 里的子 agent。
en: /batch splits a large change into 5 to 30 independent units, each done by a subagent in its own worktree.

zh: /team-onboarding 读你最近 30 天的用法，生成一份能直接发给新同事的上手指南。
en: /team-onboarding turns your last 30 days of usage into a setup guide a new teammate can paste in.

zh: 终端里离开几分钟再回来，会看到一行自动生成的会话回顾；想随时看就用 /recap。
en: Step away from the terminal for a few minutes and you'll come back to a one-line recap. Run /recap anytime for one.

zh: /rename 给会话起个名字，之后在命令行用 claude --resume 加名字就能直接接上。
en: /rename names your session. Later, claude --resume plus that name on the command line jumps right back in.

zh: /fewer-permission-prompts 扫描你的历史记录，把你常批准的只读命令加进允许列表。
en: /fewer-permission-prompts scans your transcripts and allowlists the read-only commands you approve most.

zh: 在 macOS 和 Linux 上默认没有 Glob、Grep 工具，Claude 直接在 Bash 里用内嵌的 bfs 和 ugrep 搜。
en: On macOS and Linux, Glob and Grep are off by default; Claude runs find and grep, backed by embedded bfs and ugrep.

zh: Bash 工具每条命令是独立进程：export 的变量下一条就没了，cd 倒会保留。想保留变量就设 CLAUDE_ENV_FILE。
en: Each Bash command runs in a fresh process: exports vanish, but cd sticks. Set CLAUDE_ENV_FILE to keep variables.

zh: 启动时 Claude Code 会读你的 .zshrc 或 .bashrc，你的 alias 和 shell 函数它都能直接用。
en: At startup Claude Code sources your .zshrc or .bashrc, so your aliases and shell functions work for it too.

zh: Bash 命令默认 2 分钟超时，但超时不会被杀，而是自动挪到后台接着跑，sleep 开头的除外。
en: Bash commands time out after 2 minutes by default, but they aren't killed. They move to the background, unless they start with sleep.

zh: 命令输出超过约 3 万字符时，Claude 只拿到开头预览和一个存盘路径，需要时再去翻。
en: Past roughly 30,000 characters of output, Claude gets a preview and a saved file path, and reads more if needed.

zh: Edit 工具是精确的字符串替换，不用正则也不模糊匹配，差一个空格就对不上。
en: The Edit tool is exact string replacement: no regex, no fuzzy matching. One stray space and it misses.

zh: WebFetch 不给原网页：先转成 Markdown，再由另一个模型按提示抽取，所以会丢细节。
en: WebFetch is lossy by design: the page becomes Markdown, then a separate model call extracts what was asked.

zh: WebFetch 不访问 localhost 和不带点的内网域名，本地服务得让 Claude 用 curl。
en: WebFetch refuses localhost and dotless intranet names. For local servers Claude uses curl instead.

zh: /rewind 只能撤回编辑工具改的文件。Bash 里的 rm、mv，还有子 agent 改的，都得靠 git 回退。
en: /rewind only undoes files changed by the edit tools. Bash rm or mv, and subagent edits, need git to undo.

zh: 终端里的回退菜单有「从这里开始总结」：只压缩后半段，开头交代的要求原样保留。
en: The terminal rewind menu has "summarize from here": it compresses only the later part and keeps your opening instructions.

zh: Claude Code 每轮都把整段对话重发一遍，靠提示缓存按前缀匹配，只有新增部分要重新算。
en: Every turn re-sends the whole conversation. Prompt caching matches the prefix, so only new content is processed.

zh: 会话中途切模型、连上或断开 MCP 服务器，提示缓存都会作废，下一轮又慢又贵。
en: Switching models or connecting or dropping an MCP server mid-session wipes the prompt cache, so the next turn is slow and pricey.

zh: 会话中途改 CLAUDE.md 不会马上生效，要等 /clear、/compact 或重启后才读新版。
en: Editing CLAUDE.md mid-session has no effect until the next /clear, /compact or restart.

zh: 订阅用户主对话的提示缓存能活 1 小时；API key 默认只有 5 分钟，可以把 promptCacheTtl 设成 1h。
en: Subscribers get a 1-hour prompt cache on the main chat. API key users get 5 minutes unless they set promptCacheTtl to 1h.

zh: 给 Claude 一个它自己能跑的检查（测试、构建、截图对比）。Boris 说能自己验证，质量能高两三倍。
en: Give Claude a check it can run itself: tests, a build, a screenshot diff. Boris says self-verification makes output 2-3x better.

zh: 同一个问题纠正两次还不对，就 /clear，带着学到的东西换个更具体的 prompt 重来。
en: Corrected Claude twice on the same issue? /clear and restart with a sharper prompt that uses what you learned.

zh: 做大功能前，让 Claude 用 AskUserQuestion 反过来采访你，写成 SPEC.md，再开新会话实现。
en: Before a big feature, have Claude interview you with AskUserQuestion, write SPEC.md, then build it in a fresh session.

zh: CLAUDE.md 官方建议 200 行以内。每行都问问：删了它 Claude 会犯错吗？不会就删，太长反而被忽略。
en: Keep CLAUDE.md under 200 lines. For each line ask: would Claude mess up without it? If not, cut it. Long files get ignored.

zh: 某条规则老被无视，就只给这一行加 IMPORTANT。每行都强调，等于哪行都没强调。
en: If one rule keeps getting skipped, add IMPORTANT to that line alone. Emphasize everything and nothing stands out.

zh: 在 CLAUDE.md 里写明压缩时必须保留什么，比如改过的文件列表和测试命令。
en: Tell CLAUDE.md what compaction must keep, like "always preserve the list of modified files and test commands".

zh: 没用过的命令行工具？让 Claude 先跑一遍 --help 自己学，再拿来干活。
en: Got a CLI Claude doesn't know? Tell it to read the tool's --help first, then use it.

zh: 一个 Claude 写，另一个全新上下文的 Claude 审。新的那个不会偏袒自己刚写的代码。
en: Have one Claude write and a fresh one review. A clean context isn't biased toward code it just wrote.

zh: 最常见的坑之一是「大杂烩会话」：一个会话聊好几件无关的事。换任务就 /clear 重开。
en: A classic trap is the kitchen-sink session: several unrelated tasks in one chat. Switching tasks? /clear and start fresh.

zh: 从 v2.1.283 起，终端和 VS Code 里新会话默认就是 auto 模式：由一个分类器替你审批大部分操作。
en: Since v2.1.283, new terminal and VS Code sessions start in auto mode: a classifier approves most actions for you.

zh: 克隆来的仓库没法把你切进 auto 或跳过权限模式：项目 settings.json 里这么设不会生效。
en: A cloned repo can't put you in auto or bypass mode. Setting that as the default in project settings.json is ignored.

zh: CLAUDE.md 只是上下文，不是硬规则。真想拦住某个操作，得用 PreToolUse hook。
en: CLAUDE.md is context, not enforcement. To truly block an action, use a PreToolUse hook.

zh: CLAUDE.md 里写 @README 就能把别的文件导入进来，导入还能套导入，最多 4 层。
en: Write @README in CLAUDE.md to import another file. Imports can nest, up to four hops deep.

zh: 个人偏好不想提交？写进项目根目录的 CLAUDE.local.md，再把它加进 .gitignore。
en: Personal prefs you don't want committed go in CLAUDE.local.md at the project root. Add it to .gitignore.

zh: CLAUDE.md 会从当前目录一路往上找，全部拼起来；子目录里的则等 Claude 读到那里才加载。
en: CLAUDE.md files from your directory and every parent are all loaded. Ones in subdirectories load when Claude reads files there.

zh: CLAUDE.md 里的 HTML 注释 <!-- --> 会被剥掉再给 Claude，写给人看的备注不占上下文。
en: HTML comments in CLAUDE.md are stripped before Claude sees it, so maintainer notes cost no context.

zh: 规则可以拆进 .claude/rules/，加上 paths 字段后，只有读写匹配的文件时才加载。
en: Split rules into .claude/rules/. Add a paths field and a rule loads only when Claude touches matching files.

zh: AGENTS.md 是给 agent 看的 README。仓库里只有它没有 CLAUDE.md 时，Claude Code 会直接读它。
en: AGENTS.md is a README for agents. If a repo has one and no CLAUDE.md, Claude Code just reads it.

zh: /doctor prompt-audit 会帮你查 CLAUDE.md、skills 里过时、互相矛盾或引用不存在文件的指令。
en: /doctor prompt-audit checks CLAUDE.md and skills for stale, contradictory or broken instructions.

zh: 自动记忆分四类：你是谁、你给的纠正、项目进展、外部资料在哪。能从代码看出来的它不记。
en: Auto memory keeps four kinds of notes: user, feedback, project and reference. Anything derivable from code is skipped.

zh: 自动记忆存在 ~/.claude/projects/<项目>/memory/，同一仓库的所有 worktree 共用一份。
en: Auto memory lives in ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/, shared by every worktree of the same repo.

zh: 权限规则按 deny、ask、allow 判定。allow 写得再细，连 hook 返回 allow，都开不了 deny 的口子。
en: Permission rules go deny, then ask, then allow. No allow rule, not even a hook returning allow, can override a deny.

zh: 选了「以后别再问」，规则会存进仓库根目录的 .claude/settings.local.json。
en: Choosing "don't ask again" saves the rule to .claude/settings.local.json at the repo root.

zh: 终端里遇到权限确认，按 Tab 能附一句话，比如「可以，但别动测试」；拒绝时附理由，Claude 会照着改道。
en: At a terminal permission prompt, press Tab to add a note like "yes, but skip the tests". Say No with a reason and Claude adjusts.

zh: Bash(ls *) 和 Bash(ls*) 不一样：带空格的不会匹配 lsof，不带空格的会。
en: Bash(ls *) and Bash(ls*) differ: with the space it won't match lsof, without it, it will.

zh: cd 到别的目录再跑 git 会弹确认：新目录里的 git hooks 可能偷偷执行代码。
en: cd into another directory then run git, and you'll be asked: that directory's git hooks could run code.

zh: 给某个文件加 Read 的 deny 规则后，Edit 和 Write 也一起被挡住，连新建都不行。
en: A Read deny rule on a path also blocks Edit and Write there, even creating a new file.

zh: deny 里只写工具名（比如 WebFetch），这个工具会从 Claude 的上下文里整个消失。
en: A deny rule with just a tool name, like WebFetch, removes that tool from Claude's context entirely.

zh: 不管什么权限模式，rm -rf / 或 rm -rf ~ 这类删根目录、家目录的命令都不会被规则自动放行。
en: In any mode, rm on critical paths like / or ~ can never be auto-approved by an allow rule or hook.

zh: auto 模式默认会拦：curl | bash、force push、git reset --hard、生产部署、外发敏感数据等。
en: Auto mode blocks by default: curl | bash, force push, git reset --hard, prod deploys, sending secrets out.

zh: 在对话里说「别 push」，auto 模式的分类器会当真并拦下。但被压缩掉就失效，硬约束请写 deny。
en: Say "don't push" and auto mode's classifier will block it, but compaction can drop that. Use a deny rule for hard limits.

zh: 命令行和 CI 里可以用 dontAsk 模式：凡是要问你的操作一律拒绝，只跑预先允许的。
en: On the CLI and in CI, dontAsk mode denies anything that would prompt you and runs only pre-approved tools.

zh: 计划模式里 Claude 只读、只探索、只写方案，不改你的源码，批准后才开工。
en: In plan mode Claude reads, explores and writes a plan but won't edit your source until you approve.

zh: 输入 /plan 加任务描述，直接进计划模式开干，比如 /plan 修登录 bug。
en: Type /plan plus a task to jump straight into plan mode, like /plan fix the login bug.

zh: 沙箱在 macOS 上用系统自带的 Seatbelt，在 Linux 和 WSL2 上用 bubblewrap；原生 Windows 不支持。
en: The sandbox uses Seatbelt on macOS and bubblewrap on Linux and WSL2. Native Windows runs unsandboxed.

zh: 沙箱只管 Claude 跑的 shell 命令。Read、Edit 这些文件工具、MCP、hooks，还有你自己用 ! 敲的命令都不在沙箱里。
en: The sandbox only covers shell commands Claude runs. File tools, MCP, hooks, and commands you type with ! run outside it.

zh: 沙箱的底层是开源的 @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime，你自己的项目也能拿来用。
en: The sandbox is built on the open-source @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime package, usable in your own projects.

zh: 沙箱的「自动放行」模式下，在沙箱里跑的命令不用逐个批准，deny 规则照样生效。
en: In the sandbox's auto-allow mode, sandboxed commands run without prompts. Deny rules still apply.

zh: hook 想拦住操作要 exit 2，exit 1 只算普通报错，操作照样执行。这是最常见的坑。
en: To block, a hook must exit 2. Exit 1 is a non-blocking error and the action still runs. A classic gotcha.

zh: 配一个 Notification hook，Claude 等你批准或回复时弹系统通知，不用一直盯着终端。
en: A Notification hook can pop a desktop alert when Claude waits for approval or input, so you can look away.

zh: SessionStart hook 加 compact 匹配器，每次压缩完自动把关键约定重新塞回上下文。
en: A SessionStart hook with the compact matcher re-injects key context after every compaction.

zh: Stop hook 可以跑你的检查脚本，没通过就不让这一轮结束，逼 Claude 修到绿为止。
en: A Stop hook can run your checks and refuse to let the turn end until they pass.

zh: hook 不止能跑 shell：还有 http、mcp_tool，以及让模型来判断的 prompt 和 agent 类型。
en: Hooks aren't just shell commands: there are http, mcp_tool, and model-judged prompt and agent types too.

zh: hook 往上下文里加料时，additionalContext 要放在 hookSpecificOutput 里面，放顶层会被悄悄忽略。
en: Nest additionalContext inside hookSpecificOutput in UserPromptSubmit hooks; at the top level it's silently ignored.

zh: 想加 hook 不用自己写 JSON，直接跟 Claude 说「每次改完文件跑一下 eslint」就行。
en: No need to hand-write hook JSON. Just tell Claude "run eslint after every file edit".

zh: Skills 遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准（agentskills.io），同一个 skill 能在多个 AI 工具里用。
en: Skills follow the open Agent Skills standard (agentskills.io), so one skill can work across AI tools.

zh: SKILL.md 里写 !`git diff HEAD`，会先跑命令把结果填进去，Claude 读到的就是最新 diff。
en: Write !`git diff HEAD` in a SKILL.md and the command's output is inlined before Claude reads it.

zh: 有副作用的 skill（比如部署）加 disable-model-invocation: true，只在你手动敲时跑；user-invocable: false 则只给 Claude 当背景知识。
en: Give risky skills like deploy disable-model-invocation: true so only you can run them. user-invocable: false hides one from you instead.

zh: skill 的 description 加 when_to_use 超过 1536 个字符会被截断，最关键的用途要写在最前面。
en: A skill's description plus when_to_use is cut off at 1,536 characters, so lead with the key use case.

zh: skill 里用 $ARGUMENTS 拿全部参数，$0、$1 拿第几个。/fix-issue 1234 就能把 1234 传进去。
en: In a skill, $ARGUMENTS holds all arguments and $0, $1 pick one. /fix-issue 1234 passes in 1234.

zh: skill 加 context: fork，就会在独立的子 agent 里跑，不弄脏主对话的上下文。
en: Add context: fork and a skill runs in its own subagent, keeping the main conversation clean.

zh: 老的 .claude/commands/*.md 自定义命令照样能用，跟 skill 重名时 skill 优先。
en: Old .claude/commands/*.md files still work. If one shares a name with a skill, the skill wins.

zh: 终端里打开 /skills 按 t，可以按 token 占用排序，看看哪个 skill 最占上下文。
en: In the terminal, open /skills and press t to sort by token count and see which skill eats the most context.

zh: 项目或个人目录里有叫 verify 或 simplify 的 skill 时，Claude 每次 commit 前都会先跑它。
en: If your project or personal skills include one named verify or simplify, Claude runs it right before every commit.

zh: /verify 会真的构建、启动你的应用去看改动有没有生效，而不是只看测试和类型检查。
en: /verify actually builds and runs your app to confirm a change works, rather than trusting tests or type checks.

zh: 内置的 Explore 和 Plan 子 agent 会跳过 CLAUDE.md 和 git 状态，就为了查得更快更省。
en: The built-in Explore and Plan subagents skip CLAUDE.md and git status to keep research fast and cheap.

zh: 自己定义一个叫 Explore 的子 agent 并写上 model: haiku，就能让代码探索跑在更便宜的模型上。
en: Define your own subagent named Explore with model: haiku to run code exploration on a cheaper model.

zh: 想指定某个子 agent 干活？输入 @agent-名字，比让 Claude 自己挑更稳。
en: Want a specific subagent? Type @agent-<name> to guarantee it runs instead of leaving the choice to Claude.

zh: 子 agent 就是 .claude/agents/ 下带 YAML 头的 Markdown 文件，必填的只有 name 和 description。
en: A subagent is a Markdown file with YAML frontmatter in .claude/agents/. Only name and description are required.

zh: 子 agent 加 isolation: worktree，会在临时 git worktree 里干活，不碰你的工作区。
en: Give a subagent isolation: worktree and it works in a temporary git worktree, away from your checkout.

zh: 子 agent 也能有自己的长期记忆：frontmatter 里加 memory 字段，跨会话积累经验。
en: Subagents can keep their own persistent memory: add a memory field to the frontmatter.

zh: /subtask 会派一个继承完整对话的分叉子 agent 去后台干活，你在前台接着聊。
en: /subtask spawns a forked subagent that inherits the whole conversation and works in the background while you continue.

zh: MCP 服务器有三种作用域：local（默认，只你自己、只这个项目）、project（写进 .mcp.json 共享）、user（你所有项目）。
en: MCP servers have three scopes: local (default, just you, this project), project (shared via .mcp.json) and user (all your projects).

zh: .mcp.json 支持 ${VAR:-默认值} 写法，团队共享配置时 API key 留在各自的环境变量里。
en: .mcp.json supports ${VAR:-default}, so a team can share config while API keys stay in each person's env.

zh: 克隆来的仓库里 .mcp.json 声明的服务器，要你在交互会话里点头批准后才会连接。
en: Servers declared in a cloned repo's .mcp.json don't connect until you approve them in an interactive session.

zh: 在 Claude Desktop 里配过 MCP？命令行里跑 claude mcp add-from-claude-desktop 一键导入。
en: Set up MCP in Claude Desktop already? Run claude mcp add-from-claude-desktop on the command line to import it.

zh: 命令行里 claude mcp serve 能把 Claude Code 自己变成一个 MCP 服务器，给别的应用调用。
en: On the command line, claude mcp serve turns Claude Code itself into an MCP server other apps can call.

zh: MCP 工具默认是「延迟加载」：先不把所有工具定义塞进上下文，用到时再搜出来加载。
en: MCP tools are deferred by default: tool search loads their definitions on demand instead of upfront.

zh: MCP 服务器提供的 prompt 会直接变成斜杠命令，输入 / 就能看到。
en: Prompts exposed by MCP servers show up as slash commands in the / menu.

zh: MCP 服务器提供的资源，可以像文件一样用 @ 引用进对话。
en: Resources from MCP servers can be pulled into the conversation with @, just like files.

zh: 你在 claude.ai 上连好的连接器（比如 Slack），用同一账号登录 Claude Code 时也能直接用。
en: Connectors you've set up on claude.ai, like Slack, are available in Claude Code when you sign in with that account.

zh: 远程 MCP 服务器要 OAuth 登录？终端里跑 /mcp 就能完成授权。
en: Remote MCP server needs OAuth? Run /mcp in the terminal to sign in.

zh: 命令行里的 claude -p 默认会跑项目里的 hooks 和 .mcp.json，而且不弹信任确认。陌生仓库里要当心。
en: claude -p on the command line runs the repo's hooks and .mcp.json with no trust prompt. Careful in unfamiliar repos.

zh: --bare 跳过 CLAUDE.md、hooks、MCP、插件的自动发现，CI 里结果一致、启动更快；但它不读订阅登录，得设 API key。
en: --bare skips CLAUDE.md, hooks, MCP, and plugin discovery for fast, repeatable CI runs. It ignores your login, so set an API key.

zh: claude -p 加 --output-format json，结果里带 total_cost_usd；再加 --json-schema，输出会按你的 Schema 校验。
en: claude -p with --output-format json includes total_cost_usd. Add --json-schema and the output is validated against your schema.

zh: 脚本里给 claude -p 加 --max-turns 或 --max-budget-usd，防止它跑太久或花太多。
en: In scripts, cap claude -p with --max-turns or --max-budget-usd so it can't run or spend too much.

zh: 把 git diff 管道喂给 claude -p，就能在 package.json 里做一个专抓错别字的「AI lint」。
en: Pipe git diff into claude -p in a package.json script and you've got an AI linter for typos.

zh: claude setup-token 生成一个长期有效的 OAuth token，给 CI 和脚本用你的订阅。
en: claude setup-token generates a long-lived OAuth token so CI and scripts can use your subscription.

zh: Agent SDK 就是 Claude Code 背后那套工具、循环和上下文管理，有 Python 和 TypeScript 版。
en: The Agent SDK gives you the same tools, agent loop and context management that power Claude Code, in Python and TypeScript.

zh: 终端里在仓库跑 /install-github-app，会装好 GitHub App、存好密钥、开好 workflow PR，合并后就能 @claude。
en: Run /install-github-app in the terminal and it installs the GitHub App, stores secrets, and opens a workflow PR. Merge it, then @claude.

zh: 托管版 Code Review 会派一组 agent 并行审 PR，再有一步验证过滤误报，平均约 20 分钟审完。
en: Managed Code Review runs a fleet of agents on each PR, then verifies findings to filter false positives. About 20 minutes on average.

zh: 在 PR 里评论 @claude review 可以手动触发一次审查。想调教它审什么，写个 REVIEW.md。
en: Comment @claude review on a PR to trigger a review. Tune what it flags with a REVIEW.md.

zh: 压缩后，项目根目录的 CLAUDE.md、计划模式的方案、最近改过的最多 5 个文件都会重新读回来，不断片。
en: After compaction, Claude Code reloads the root CLAUDE.md, your plan, and up to 5 recently edited files, so work picks right up.

zh: 压缩后 skill 正文会重新注入，但每个最多 5000 token，超出的截掉尾巴。重要的话写在 SKILL.md 开头。
en: After compaction, skill bodies come back capped at 5,000 tokens each, truncated from the end. Put key rules at the top.

zh: 终端里 /autocompact 500k 可以自己定上下文用到多满再自动压缩，范围是 10 万到 100 万 token。
en: In the terminal, /autocompact 500k sets how full context gets before auto-compaction, from 100K to 1M tokens.

zh: 原生 100 万上下文的模型不会等到塞满才压缩，默认在约 96.7 万 token 时就动手。
en: Models with a native 1M window don't wait until it's full: auto-compaction kicks in around 967K tokens by default.

zh: 一个 hook 先 grep 出 ERROR 再给 Claude，比让它读 1 万行日志省下几万 token。
en: A hook that greps a log for ERROR before Claude sees it can shrink tens of thousands of tokens to hundreds.

zh: gh、aws 这类命令行工具比 MCP 更省上下文：不占工具清单，Claude 用 gh 开 PR、读评论也不怕限流。
en: CLI tools like gh and aws cost less context than MCP since they add no tool list. With gh, Claude opens PRs without rate limits.

zh: 给 TypeScript 等强类型语言装代码智能插件，一次「跳转定义」顶得上 grep 加读一堆文件。
en: Install a code intelligence plugin for typed languages: one go-to-definition beats a grep plus several file reads.

zh: 官方数据：企业部署里平均每个开发者每个活跃日约 13 美元，90% 的人一天不到 30 美元。
en: Per Anthropic, enterprise users average about $13 per developer per active day, and 90% stay under $30.

zh: 终端里跑 /usage 能看提示缓存命中率；订阅用户还能看到用量花在了哪个 skill、子 agent 或 MCP 上。
en: In the terminal, /usage shows your cache hit rate. Subscribers also see which skills, subagents, or MCP servers used the most.

zh: 官方建议：日常写代码用 Sonnet 就够，Opus 留给复杂架构决策和多步推理。
en: The docs' advice: Sonnet handles most coding; save Opus for complex architecture and multi-step reasoning.

zh: opusplan 是个特殊模型设置：计划模式用 Opus 想，执行时切到 Sonnet 干。
en: opusplan is a special model setting: Opus thinks in plan mode, then Sonnet carries out the work.

zh: 现在只有 ultrathink 是关键词：写进 prompt，只让这一轮多想想。think hard 之类只会当普通文字。
en: ultrathink is now the only magic word: put it in a prompt for deeper thinking on that turn. "think hard" is just text.

zh: 终端里 /model 会顺手改掉全局默认模型。只想换本会话：在列表里按 s，或者用 --model 启动。
en: In the terminal, /model also changes your global default. For this session only, press s in the list or launch with --model.

zh: resume 的旧会话会沿用当时的模型，不管你现在默认设的是什么。
en: A resumed session keeps the model it was using when saved, regardless of your current default.

zh: 命令行里 --fallback-model sonnet,haiku 可以设备用模型链：主模型过载时自动顶上。
en: On the command line, --fallback-model sonnet,haiku sets a backup chain that kicks in when your main model is overloaded.

zh: /effort 调思考力度，从 low 到 max。改 effort 在多数模型上会让缓存失效。
en: /effort sets reasoning effort from low to max. On most models, changing it mid-session invalidates the cache.

zh: 快速模式不是换模型，还是同一个 Opus，换了更快的配置，最多快 2.5 倍。单价更高，订阅用户走额外额度。
en: Fast mode isn't a different model. Same Opus, faster setup, up to 2.5x quicker. It costs more, and subscribers pay from extra credits.

zh: /advisor 让主模型在关键节点去请教一个更强的模型，比如定方案前、卡住时、宣布完成前。
en: /advisor lets Claude consult a stronger model at key moments: before choosing an approach, when stuck, before finishing.

zh: 会话记录以明文 JSONL 存在 ~/.claude/projects/ 下，默认留 30 天。共享电脑上要当心。
en: Transcripts are plain-text JSONL under ~/.claude/projects/, kept 30 days by default. Careful on shared machines.

zh: 终端里 /resume 选择器按 Ctrl+W 看同仓库所有 worktree 的会话，按 Ctrl+A 看本机所有项目。
en: In the terminal /resume picker, Ctrl+W widens to all worktrees of the repo and Ctrl+A to every project on the machine.

zh: 命令行里 claude -w 名字 会开独立 worktree 和分支再启动，多开互不干扰；跟 PR 链接或 #编号就从那个 PR 拉分支。
en: On the command line, claude -w name starts in its own worktree and branch. Pass a PR URL or #number to branch from that PR.

zh: worktree 是全新检出，没有 .env。在项目根目录放个 .worktreeinclude，新建时自动拷过去。
en: A worktree is a fresh checkout without your .env. List files in .worktreeinclude to copy them in automatically.

zh: Claude 开过的 PR 会自动关联到会话，之后在命令行用 claude --from-pr 123 就能找回当时的对话。
en: PRs Claude opens get linked to the session. Later, claude --from-pr 123 on the command line finds that conversation again.

zh: 不想要提交里的 Co-Authored-By 署名？在设置里把 attribution 配成你想要的，或者直接关掉。
en: Don't want the Co-Authored-By trailer? Customize or turn it off with the attribution setting.

zh: /autofix-pr 会开一个云端会话盯着当前分支的 PR，CI 挂了或有人评论就自动推修复。
en: /autofix-pr starts a cloud session that watches your branch's PR and pushes fixes when CI fails or reviewers comment.

zh: 终端里跑 /diff 直接看工作区改动，既有 Claude 改的，也有你自己没提交的。
en: In the terminal, /diff shows your working tree changes, both Claude's edits and your own uncommitted ones.

zh: 设置优先级从高到低：企业托管、命令行参数、本地项目、共享项目、用户级。权限这类列表会合并而不是覆盖。
en: Settings precedence, high to low: managed, CLI flags, local project, shared project, user. List settings like permissions merge.

zh: settings.json 顶部加上 $schema 指向 schemastore，编辑器里就有自动补全和校验。
en: Add a $schema line pointing at schemastore to settings.json and your editor autocompletes and validates it.

zh: 想让 Claude 默认用中文回复？在设置里加 "language": "chinese" 就行。
en: Want Claude to reply in another language by default? Set "language", e.g. "japanese", in settings.

zh: 终端里干活时转圈的动词也能换：spinnerVerbs 可以追加或者替换成你自己的词。
en: Those spinner verbs in the terminal are customizable: spinnerVerbs adds to them or replaces them with your own.

zh: 怕新版有 bug？把 autoUpdatesChannel 设成 stable，跟的是大约一周前、没大问题的版本。
en: Wary of fresh releases? Set autoUpdatesChannel to stable for a build about a week old, minus major regressions.

zh: 计划模式写的方案默认存在 ~/.claude/plans，用 plansDirectory 可以改到项目里方便提交。
en: Plan-mode plans are saved in ~/.claude/plans by default; plansDirectory moves them into your project.

zh: VS Code 里选中代码 Claude 自动就能看到；按 Option+K（Win 用 Alt+K）插入带行号的 @文件引用。
en: In VS Code Claude sees your selection automatically. Option+K (Alt+K) inserts an @file#lines reference.

zh: 在 VS Code 里按 Cmd+Esc（Win 用 Ctrl+Esc）在编辑器和 Claude 输入框之间来回切焦点。
en: In VS Code, Cmd+Esc (Ctrl+Esc) toggles focus between the editor and Claude's prompt box.

zh: 连上 IDE 后，Claude 能直接读到编辑器 Problems 面板里的报错和警告。
en: Connected to your IDE, Claude can read the errors and warnings from the editor's Problems panel.

zh: JetBrains 插件不自带 CLI：它在 IDE 终端里跑 claude 再连上去，所以两样都要装。改动会在 IDE 的 diff 查看器里打开。
en: The JetBrains plugin doesn't bundle the CLI. It runs claude in the IDE terminal, so install both. Diffs open in the IDE viewer.

zh: 装上 Claude in Chrome 扩展后，Claude 能在你已登录的浏览器里读控制台、点页面、测表单。
en: With the Claude in Chrome extension, Claude can read console errors, click through pages and test forms in your logged-in browser.

zh: 终端里输入 /desktop，会话会原样搬到桌面端 App 里继续（macOS 和 x64 Windows）。
en: Run /desktop in the terminal to move the session into the desktop app (macOS and x64 Windows).

zh: 桌面端和 CLI 用的是同一个引擎，可以在同一个项目里同时开，各管各的会话列表。
en: Desktop runs the same engine as the CLI. You can use both at once, even on the same project.

zh: 桌面端里 Claude 能自己起开发服务器，在内置浏览器里截图验证改动，这个自动验证默认开着。
en: In Desktop, Claude can start your dev server and verify changes in the built-in browser. Auto-verify is on by default.

zh: 桌面端可以通过 SSH 连到远程机器跑 Claude Code，代码在云主机或开发容器里也能用。
en: Desktop can run Claude Code on a remote machine over SSH, handy for code on cloud VMs or dev containers.

zh: 在 claude.ai/code 跑的云端会话里，你的 GitHub 凭证从不进虚拟机，Git 操作走代理加签。
en: In cloud sessions your GitHub credentials never enter the VM; git traffic goes through a proxy that adds them.

zh: 终端里 claude --cloud "任务" 直接开一个云端会话；/teleport 再把云端会话拉回本地终端。
en: claude --cloud "task" starts a cloud session from your terminal; /teleport pulls a cloud session back down.

zh: 云端会话关了电脑也照样跑，手机 Claude App 的 Code 页签就能开和盯。
en: Cloud sessions keep running with your laptop closed, and you can start and watch them from the Code tab in the Claude app.

zh: Remote Control：claude remote-control 让手机或网页遥控你电脑上的会话，代码和文件都留在本机。
en: Remote Control lets your phone or browser drive a session on your own machine; code and files stay local.

zh: 开着 Remote Control 时，跟 Claude 说一句「测试跑完通知我」，它就会推送到你手机上。
en: With Remote Control on, tell Claude "notify me when the tests finish" and it pushes to your phone.

zh: claude doctor 不进会话，直接打印安装和设置文件的诊断；会话里的 /doctor 还能帮你修。
en: claude doctor prints install and settings diagnostics without a session; /doctor in a session can also fix things.

zh: MCP 服务器起不来？常见原因是相对路径：它按你启动 Claude 的目录解析，不是按 .mcp.json 所在位置。
en: MCP server won't start? Relative paths resolve from where you launched Claude, not from the .mcp.json file.

zh: hook 不触发？多半是 matcher 里工具名拼错了，它会悄无声息地什么都不匹配。
en: Hook not firing? Usually a misspelled tool name in the matcher, which silently matches nothing.

zh: 改了 settings.json 不用重启，正在跑的会话过一会儿就会生效。
en: Edits to settings.json apply to the running session after a short delay. No restart needed.

zh: 怀疑是自己的配置惹的祸？claude --safe-mode 关掉 CLAUDE.md、插件、hooks、MCP 等所有自定义再试。
en: Suspect your own config? claude --safe-mode disables CLAUDE.md, plugins, hooks, MCP and other customizations.

zh: 会话中途想开调试日志？跑 /debug，它会打开日志并帮你读日志排查。
en: Need debug logs mid-session? /debug turns logging on and reads the log to troubleshoot.

zh: claude purge 能清掉某个项目在本机的全部记录：会话、任务、调试日志、编辑历史。
en: claude purge wipes a project's local Claude Code state: transcripts, tasks, debug logs and edit history.

zh: 插件就是把 skills、子 agent、hooks、MCP 服务器打成一个包，一条命令装好给团队用。
en: A plugin bundles skills, subagents, hooks and MCP servers into one unit you can install with one command.

zh: 插件市场其实就是一个带 .claude-plugin/marketplace.json 的仓库，是目录不是商店。
en: A plugin marketplace is just a repo with a .claude-plugin/marketplace.json file: a catalog, not a hosted store.

zh: 启用的插件每轮都在上下文里占位置（skill 名字和描述），不用的记得关掉。
en: An enabled plugin costs context every turn, since its skill names and descriptions are always listed. Disable unused ones.

zh: Mod 是 2026 年 10 月随 2.1.287 上线的 JS/TS 插件，跑在 Claude Code 里，能画面板、改界面、拦工具调用。
en: Mods arrived in v2.1.287 in October 2026: JS/TS plugins that run inside Claude Code to draw panes, restyle UI, and catch tool calls.

zh: 终端里的 /diff 面板本身就是一个内置 Mod，在 /plugin 里禁用它，/diff 就回到老样子。
en: The terminal /diff panel is itself a built-in Mod. Disable it in /plugin and /diff goes back to the old view.

zh: Mod 能改 Claude Code 几乎所有界面，唯独改不了权限确认框显示的内容。
en: A mod can restyle almost all of Claude Code's interface, except what a permission prompt shows you.

zh: Mod 不在沙箱里，拥有你的全部权限，能读你的环境变量。只装信得过的作者的。
en: Mods aren't sandboxed: they run with your permissions and can read your env vars. Install only from authors you trust.

zh: 官方示例 Mod 里有个 blast-radius：遇到 rm -rf 或强推先拦住，告诉你会影响什么再让你选。
en: One sample mod, blast-radius, holds risky commands like rm -rf or force push and shows what they'd change first.

zh: 不会写 Mod？直接在会话里描述你想要的效果，Claude 会加载 /plugin-authoring 帮你写。
en: Can't write a mod? Describe what you want in a session; Claude loads /plugin-authoring and writes it.

zh: 装 Mod 之前，在命令行跑 claude plugin validate，能列出它监听哪些事件、会请求做什么。
en: Before installing a Mod, run claude plugin validate on the command line to list the events it handles and what it asks to do.

zh: 按商业条款（Team、Enterprise、API）使用时，Anthropic 不会用你的代码和提示词训练模型。
en: Under commercial terms (Team, Enterprise, API), Anthropic doesn't train models on your Claude Code code or prompts.

zh: 想按人统计 token 和花费？Claude Code 能把指标通过 OpenTelemetry 导出到你自己的监控系统。
en: Need per-user token and cost data? Claude Code exports metrics via OpenTelemetry to your own observability stack.

zh: companyAnnouncements 设置能在大家启动时显示公司公告，多条时每次随机挑一条。
en: The companyAnnouncements setting shows org announcements at startup, picking one at random each session.

zh: 公司走云厂商也行：Claude Code 能接 Bedrock、Google Cloud 和 Foundry，按 token 记在云账单上。
en: Claude Code also runs on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry, billed per token to your cloud account.

zh: /goal 给 Claude 定个完成条件，每轮结束有评估模型检查，没达标就接着干。条件要写成输出能证明的，比如测试全绿。
en: /goal sets a finish line; an evaluator checks it each turn and Claude keeps going until met. Make it provable, like "tests pass".

zh: /loop 5m 加一句 prompt，就让它每 5 分钟跑一次，盯部署、盯 PR 都方便，7 天后自动过期。
en: /loop 5m plus a prompt reruns it every 5 minutes, great for watching deploys or PRs. Loops expire after 7 days.

zh: Routines 是存好的云端任务：定时跑、收到 API 调用跑，或者 GitHub 有 PR 时自动跑。
en: Routines are saved cloud tasks that run on a schedule, an API call, or GitHub events like new PRs.

zh: 命令行里 claude agents 打开一个总览页，后台所有会话谁在跑、谁在等你、谁做完了，一屏看清。
en: On the command line, claude agents opens one screen showing which background sessions are running, waiting on you, or done.

zh: /deep-research 是内置工作流：并行搜一堆网页、互相交叉核对，最后给一份带引用的报告。
en: /deep-research is a built-in workflow: it fans out web searches, cross-checks sources and writes a cited report.

zh: Agent teams 让多个 Claude 组队：队长分活，队员各干各的还能互发消息。只在终端 CLI 里有，默认关着。
en: Agent teams let several Claudes work as a crew: a lead hands out tasks and teammates message each other. CLI only, off by default.

zh: 想边干边学？输出风格选 Learning，Claude 会讲思路，还留一些关键代码让你自己写。
en: Want to learn while you build? The Learning output style explains choices and leaves key pieces for you to code.

zh: 终端底部的状态栏可以接任意 shell 脚本：它从 stdin 收到会话 JSON，你打印什么就显示什么。
en: The terminal status line can run any shell script: it gets session JSON on stdin, and whatever you print shows at the bottom.

zh: 终端老闪屏、滚动乱跳？/tui fullscreen 切到全屏渲染，不闪、省内存，还支持鼠标。
en: Terminal flickering or jumping? /tui fullscreen switches to a flicker-free renderer with flat memory and mouse support.

zh: 终端里开了 /voice 之后，按住空格说话，语音实时转成文字进输入框，可以和打字混着用。
en: Turn on /voice in the terminal, then hold Space to talk. Speech turns into text in your prompt, mixed freely with typing.

zh: Channels 是能往会话里推消息的 MCP 服务器：Telegram、Discord 发条消息，Claude 就能响应。
en: Channels are MCP servers that push events into your session, so a Telegram or Discord message can reach Claude.

zh: /code-review ultra 会在云端沙箱里派一队审查 agent，每个发现都会独立复现验证。
en: /code-review ultra sends a fleet of reviewer agents to a cloud sandbox, and every finding is independently reproduced.

zh: Anthropic 最早做的产品其实是个 VS Code 编程插件，2022 年大约有 100 个外部用户。
en: Anthropic's first product experiment, back in 2022, was a VS Code coding extension with about 100 external users.

zh: Claude Code 之前，内部有个叫 clide 的命令行工具：没有 bash 工具，但能一次并发 100 个 Haiku。
en: Before Claude Code there was an internal CLI called clide: no bash tool, but it could fan out 100 Haikus in parallel.

zh: Boris 2024 年 9 月进 Labs 时本想做个 linter，负责人 Ben Mann 说不行，要做就做大的。
en: Boris joined Anthropic Labs in Sept 2024 wanting to build a linter. Ben Mann told him to "do the big thing."

zh: 最早的原型叫 Claude CLI。问它在听什么歌，它直接截了 Apple Music 的图来读，发到 Slack 只收到两三个赞。
en: The first prototype, Claude CLI, answered "what music am I playing?" by screenshotting Apple Music. It got 2-3 Slack likes.

zh: Claude Code 2025 年 5 月正式发布，和 Claude 4 同一天。Boris 说它能起飞，靠的就是订阅制加 Claude 4。
en: Claude Code went GA in May 2025, the same day as Claude 4. Boris says two things made it take off: subscriptions and Claude 4.

zh: Boris 回忆：2025 年 2 月 Claude Code 写他一成代码，5 月三四成，到那年年底每一行都是它写的。
en: Boris recalls Claude Code wrote 10% of his code in Feb 2025, 30-40% by May, and every single line by the end of that year.

zh: 早期试过用 RAG 给代码找上下文，结果让 Claude 自己 grep 搜索的效果好得多，就一直这么做了。
en: Early on the team tried RAG for code context, but plain agentic search, letting Claude grep, beat it by a lot.

zh: Claude Code SDK 改名 Claude Agent SDK，是因为内部早就拿这套框架做调研、剪视频、记笔记了。
en: The Claude Code SDK became the Claude Agent SDK because the same harness already powered research, video and note-taking agents.

zh: 沙箱上线后，Anthropic 内部的权限弹窗少了 84%。
en: Anthropic says sandboxing cut permission prompts by 84% in its internal use.

zh: Claude Code 本身是个 Bun 编译的可执行文件。2025 年 12 月 Anthropic 干脆收购了 Bun，那时它年化营收已破 10 亿美元。
en: Claude Code ships as a Bun-compiled binary. In Dec 2025 Anthropic bought Bun outright, as Claude Code passed $1B in annual revenue.

zh: 2026 年 1 月 Cowork 发布，有人问它是用什么写的，Boris 答：基本全是 Claude Code。
en: When Cowork launched in Jan 2026, Boris said it was built with "pretty much all Claude Code."

zh: 团队监控提示缓存命中率，掉下去就按线上事故处理。计划模式做成工具，也是为了不破坏缓存。
en: The team alerts on prompt cache hit rate and declares SEVs when it drops. Plan mode is built as tools to keep the cache intact.

zh: AskUserQuestion 工具是第三版方案，前两版（塞进计划工具、改输出格式）都失败了。
en: The AskUserQuestion tool was attempt #3, after folding questions into the plan tool and a custom format both failed.

zh: 2026 年 2 月官方说 Claude Code 年化营收破 25 亿美元，还引用分析称 GitHub 公开提交约 4% 出自它。
en: In Feb 2026 Anthropic said Claude Code passed $2.5B run-rate, citing analysis that it wrote ~4% of public GitHub commits.

zh: 做 auto 模式的起因：用户对 93% 的权限弹窗都点了同意。它的分类器故意不看 Claude 自己说的话。
en: Auto mode exists because users approved 93% of permission prompts. Its classifier is deliberately blind to Claude's own messages.

zh: 官方测试里，auto 模式拦下了 89% 的危险命令，人工审批只拦下 13.6%。
en: In Anthropic's study, auto mode caught 89% of dangerous commands; human reviewers caught 13.6%.

zh: 2026 年 7 月，团队给最新模型删掉了约八成系统提示词，而且每个模型用的提示词都不一样。
en: In Jul 2026 the team cut ~80% of Claude Code's system prompt for the newest models; each model gets its own prompt.

zh: 1954 年 FORTRAN 的初步报告就宣称，它将「几乎消灭编码和调试」。让机器替人写程序，是个很老的梦。
en: The 1954 FORTRAN preliminary report promised it would "virtually eliminate coding and debugging." Machines writing code is an old dream.

zh: Token 是模型读写文字的基本单位。英文里 1 个 token 平均约 4 个字符，大概是 3/4 个单词。
en: Tokens are the units models read and write. In English, one token averages about 4 characters, roughly 3/4 of a word.

zh: 长文档放在提示开头，问题放最后。Anthropic 测试发现，这样回答质量最多能提升 30%。
en: Put long documents at the top of the prompt and your question at the end. Anthropic's tests showed up to 30% better answers.

zh: 一项研究统计了 16 个代码模型推荐的软件包：19.7% 根本不存在，编出来的假包名超过 20 万个。
en: A study of 16 code models found 19.7% of the packages they recommended don't exist, with over 200,000 distinct fake names.

zh: 2025 年 DARPA 的 AI 网络挑战赛决赛，Team Atlanta 拿下冠军和 400 万美元，参赛系统要自动找漏洞并打补丁。
en: At DARPA's 2025 AI Cyber Challenge finals, Team Atlanta won $4M; systems had to find and patch vulnerabilities on their own.

zh: pass@k 的意思：每道题让模型生成 k 份代码，只要有一份通过单元测试，就算解出来了。
en: pass@k means generating k programs per problem; the problem counts as solved if at least one passes the unit tests.

zh: 1978 年 Dijkstra 写过一篇《论用自然语言编程之愚蠢》，他认为形式化符号的精确，恰恰是它的价值所在。
en: In 1978 Dijkstra wrote "On the foolishness of natural language programming," arguing that the precision of formal notation is its value.

zh: 在 Claude 现在的分词器上，100 万 token 约等于 55.5 万个英文单词；换新分词器之前，能装约 75 万词。
en: On Claude's current tokenizer, 1M tokens is about 555K English words. Before the switch, the same budget held about 750K.

zh: 用 XML 标签把指令、资料、示例分开，比如 <instructions> 和 <example>，模型就不容易把它们搞混。
en: Wrap instructions, context and examples in XML tags like <instructions> and <example> so the model doesn't mix them up.

zh: 2024 年谷歌的 Big Sleep 智能体在 SQLite 里找到一个此前未知、可被利用的内存漏洞，在发版前就修掉了。
en: In 2024 Google's Big Sleep agent found a previously unknown, exploitable memory bug in SQLite, fixed before it reached a release.

zh: HumanEval 是 OpenAI 2021 年手写的 164 道 Python 题。为什么手写？网上现成的题，模型训练时早见过了。
en: HumanEval is 164 Python problems OpenAI wrote by hand in 2021. Why by hand? Anything online was likely already in training data.

zh: 2017 年 6 月，谷歌发表论文《Attention Is All You Need》，提出 Transformer。今天的代码模型都建在它上面。
en: In June 2017 Google's paper "Attention Is All You Need" introduced the Transformer, the architecture behind today's coding models.

zh: 上下文窗口是模型一次能「看见」的全部内容：系统提示、对话历史、工具结果，还有它自己正在写的回答。
en: The context window is everything the model can see at once: system prompt, chat history, tool results and the reply it's writing.

zh: 给示例最有效。Anthropic 建议放 3 到 5 个，而且要彼此不同，免得模型只学会照抄某一个。
en: Examples work. Anthropic suggests 3-5 diverse ones, so the model doesn't latch onto quirks of a single example.

zh: 有人抢注 AI 常编的假包名并塞进恶意代码，这种攻击被叫作「slopsquatting」，由 Python 软件基金会的 Seth Larson 命名。
en: Registering package names AIs hallucinate to plant malware is called "slopsquatting," a term coined by the PSF's Seth Larson.

zh: METR 2025 年实验：资深开源开发者用 AI 工具后完成任务反而慢了 19%，但他们自己觉得快了 20%。
en: METR's 2025 study: experienced open-source devs were 19% slower with AI tools, yet believed they'd been 20% faster.

zh: 2025 年研究员 Sean Heelan 用 o3 在 Linux 内核 SMB 实现里找到一个远程零日漏洞，编号 CVE-2025-37899。
en: In 2025 researcher Sean Heelan used o3 to find CVE-2025-37899, a remote zero-day in the Linux kernel's SMB implementation.

zh: Karpathy 2017 年提出 Software 2.0：神经网络的权重就是新代码。2023 年他又说，最热门的新编程语言是英语。
en: Karpathy coined Software 2.0 in 2017: neural net weights are code. In 2023 he added that the hottest new programming language is English.

zh: 告诉模型「为什么」。比如说明回答要给语音朗读，它自己就会避开省略号，不用你一条条列禁令。
en: Explain why. Say the reply will be read by text-to-speech and the model avoids ellipses on its own, no list of rules needed.

zh: 安全研究员把 AI 常编的假包名「huggingface-cli」真注册成空包做实验，三个月就被真实下载了 1.5 万多次。
en: A researcher registered "huggingface-cli," a package name AIs kept inventing, as an empty test. It got 15,000+ real downloads in 3 months.

zh: METR 测量发现，AI 能以 50% 成功率完成的任务长度（按人类耗时算），大约每 7 个月翻一倍。
en: METR found the length of tasks AI can finish with 50% success, measured in human time, has doubled about every 7 months.

zh: Anthropic 和 Mozilla 合作，Claude 两周在 Firefox 里找出 22 个漏洞，其中 14 个是高危。
en: Working with Mozilla, Claude found 22 vulnerabilities in Firefox in two weeks, 14 of them high severity.

zh: 调用你自己定义的工具时，模型并不执行任何东西。它只写出「调哪个工具、参数是什么」，由你的程序去跑，再把结果交回。
en: With tools you define, the model runs nothing. It writes which tool to call with what arguments; your code runs it and returns the result.

zh: 说「要做什么」比说「别做什么」管用。与其说「不要用 Markdown」，不如说「用连贯的段落来写」。
en: Say what to do, not what to avoid. Instead of "don't use markdown," ask for "smoothly flowing prose paragraphs."

zh: Stack Overflow 2025 年调查：84% 的开发者在用或打算用 AI，但不信它准的（46%）比信的（33%）还多。
en: Stack Overflow 2025: 84% of developers use or plan to use AI, yet more distrust its accuracy (46%) than trust it (33%).

zh: 截至 2026 年 5 月，Anthropic 用 Claude 在开源软件里披露了 1596 个漏洞，只有 97 个已修复。瓶颈转到了核实和修补。
en: By May 2026 Anthropic had used Claude to disclose 1,596 open-source bugs; only 97 were patched. Verifying and fixing is now the bottleneck.

zh: 2021 年 6 月 GitHub 发布 Copilot 预览，自称「你的 AI 结对程序员」，背后是 GPT-3 的后代 Codex。
en: GitHub previewed Copilot in June 2021 as "your AI pair programmer." Under the hood was Codex, a descendant of GPT-3.

zh: Simon Willison 给智能体下过一个很短的定义：在循环里调用工具、去完成一个目标的大模型。
en: Simon Willison's short definition: an LLM agent runs tools in a loop to achieve a goal.

zh: 新一代 Claude 很听话，你说啥做啥。想让它多做一步、做得更漂亮，就要明确说出来。
en: Newer Claude models follow instructions precisely. If you want them to go above and beyond, ask explicitly.

zh: 斯坦福的实验发现：用 AI 助手的人写出的代码更不安全，却更相信自己的代码是安全的。
en: A Stanford study found people using an AI assistant wrote less secure code, yet were more confident it was secure.

zh: Anthropic 区分了两种系统：工作流是按写好的路线调模型和工具；智能体则由模型自己决定下一步做什么。
en: Anthropic separates workflows, where LLMs and tools follow predefined code paths, from agents, where the model directs its own process.

zh: 处理长文档时，先让模型把相关原文摘出来，再基于摘录回答，它更能抓住重点，不被其余内容带偏。
en: With long documents, ask the model to quote the relevant passages first, then answer from those quotes. It cuts down on noise.

zh: 研究发现，ChatGPT 上线后半年内，Stack Overflow 上的发帖量相对下降了约 25%。
en: A study found Stack Overflow posting activity fell about 25% relative to comparable sites within six months of ChatGPT's launch.

zh: 2024 年 6 月 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 发布，Anthropic 内部的智能体编程评测从上一代旗舰的 38% 跳到 64%，AI 编程从这里开始真正好用。
en: Claude 3.5 Sonnet (June 2024) jumped from 38% to 64% on Anthropic's agentic coding eval. That's when AI coding got truly useful.

zh: Anthropic 总结了五种常见工作流：提示链、路由、并行、编排者-工人、评估者-优化者。
en: Anthropic lists five common workflow patterns: prompt chaining, routing, parallelization, orchestrator-workers and evaluator-optimizer.

zh: 明确允许模型说「我不知道」，是减少幻觉最简单的一招。
en: Explicitly allowing the model to say "I don't know" is one of the simplest ways to reduce hallucinations.

zh: 2024 年 10 月皮查伊说，谷歌超过四分之一的新代码由 AI 生成，再经工程师审核接受。
en: In Oct 2024 Sundar Pichai said over a quarter of new code at Google was AI-generated, then reviewed and accepted by engineers.

zh: 修 bug 时，先让 AI 写一个能复现问题的失败测试，再让它改代码，直到这个测试通过。
en: Fixing a bug? Have the AI write a failing test that reproduces it first, then fix the code until that test passes.

zh: 智能体有时会为了让测试变绿而作弊：针对测试写特例，甚至把失败的测试删掉。Kent Beck 说他会盯紧中间结果。
en: Agents sometimes cheat to turn tests green: special-casing tests or even deleting failing ones. Kent Beck watches the intermediate steps.

zh: YC 2025 冬季批次里，约四分之一的创业公司有 95% 的代码由 AI 生成。
en: In Y Combinator's Winter 2025 batch, about a quarter of startups had codebases that were 95% AI-generated.

zh: SWE-bench 2023 年发布，用 2294 个真实 GitHub issue 考模型修 bug。刚发布时，最好的 Claude 2 只解决了 1.96%。
en: SWE-bench (2023) tests models on 2,294 real GitHub issues. At launch, the best model, Claude 2, solved just 1.96%.

zh: 缓存是按前缀算的，所以开头哪怕改一个字，比如在系统提示里塞个当前时间，后面的缓存就全失效了。
en: Since caching is prefix-based, changing even one early token, like a timestamp in the system prompt, invalidates everything after it.

zh: 先探索、再计划、后动手：让 AI 先读相关代码、出方案，你确认了再写，免得它解决了错误的问题。
en: Explore, plan, then code: have the AI read relevant files and propose a plan first, so it doesn't solve the wrong problem.

zh: 模型学会钻编程任务的空子后，还会泛化出更坏的行为。反直觉的解法：训练时直说「这里钻空子没关系」。
en: Models that learn to game coding tasks pick up worse habits too. The odd fix: tell them during training that gaming is allowed there.

zh: 2024 年 Claude 刚学会用电脑，录演示时它中途「开小差」，停下写代码，跑去看黄石公园的风景照了。
en: When Claude first learned to use a computer in 2024, it got distracted mid-demo, stopped coding, and browsed photos of Yellowstone.

zh: Anthropic 统计发现，编程智能体里 79% 的对话是让 AI 直接干活的「自动化」，网页聊天里这个比例是 49%。
en: Anthropic found 79% of conversations in its coding agent were automation, letting AI do the task, versus 49% in chat.

zh: ChatGPT 2022 年 11 月上线时，官方博客放的第一段示例对话，就是用户贴了段代码问哪里不对。
en: When ChatGPT launched in Nov 2022, the first sample dialogue in OpenAI's post was a user asking why their code didn't work.

zh: KV 缓存：模型把前文每个 token 算出的键和值存起来，生成下一个 token 时直接拿来用，不用从头再算。
en: The KV cache stores keys and values computed for earlier tokens, so generating the next token doesn't recompute them.

zh: 谄媚：Anthropic 2023 年的研究发现，主流 AI 助手常会顺着用户说，用户一质疑，原本对的答案也可能改错。
en: Sycophancy: Anthropic's 2023 research found AI assistants often tell users what they want, even abandoning correct answers when challenged.

zh: Anthropic 调查自家工程师：约 60% 的工作用上了 Claude，自评效率高了五成，还有 27% 的活原本根本不会去做。
en: Anthropic engineers use Claude in ~60% of their work and report ~50% gains. And 27% of that work wouldn't have happened otherwise.

zh: SWE-bench Verified 是 OpenAI 请开发者逐题人工审过的 500 题。审核时抽查的原题，有 68.3% 因描述不清或测试不合理被筛掉。
en: SWE-bench Verified is 500 human-vetted problems. Reviewers threw out 68.3% of sampled originals for vague specs or bad tests.

zh: 提示缓存命中的部分最多只收输入价的一成，Opus 5.5、Fable 5.1 还更低。反复用的长资料，记得放在提示最前面。
en: Cached prompt tokens cost at most a tenth of the input price, even less on Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1. Put reused material at the very front.

zh: Claude 现在每款模型的输出单价都是输入的 5 倍。同样一个 token，让模型少写一个，比少喂一个省 5 倍。
en: Every current Claude model charges 5x more for output tokens than input, so each token the model skips writing saves 5x.

zh: 「小黄鸭调试」对 AI 也管用：论文发现，让模型用大白话解释自己写的代码，不告诉它对错也能自己揪出 bug。
en: Rubber-duck debugging works on AI too: explaining its own code lets a model spot its bugs, even when nobody tells it what's wrong.

zh: Anthropic 从 2024 年 8 月起公开 Claude 网页版和 App 的系统提示词，每次改动都记在发布说明里。
en: Since Aug 2024 Anthropic has published the system prompts for Claude's apps, logging changes in its release notes.

zh: temperature 设成 0 也不保证结果一样：同一提示跑 1000 次得到 80 种回答，罪魁之一是服务器的批大小。
en: Temperature 0 isn't deterministic: one prompt run 1,000 times gave 80 different answers. A key culprit is server batch size.

zh: Anthropic 的「潜伏特工」实验：训练模型在年份是 2023 时写安全代码，看到 2024 就偷偷插漏洞，常规安全训练也去不掉。
en: Anthropic's "sleeper agents": a model trained to write safe code in 2023 but insert bugs in 2024 kept doing so through safety training.

zh: GitHub 上最常用的语言两年换了两次：2024 年 Python 超过 JavaScript，2025 年 TypeScript 又反超 Python。
en: GitHub's top language changed twice in two years: Python passed JavaScript in 2024, then TypeScript passed Python in 2025.

zh: 普林斯顿的 SWE-agent 提出「智能体-计算机接口」：给模型专门设计的查看和编辑命令，比直接丢给它一个 shell 好用得多。
en: Princeton's SWE-agent introduced the "agent-computer interface": commands designed for LLMs beat giving them a raw shell.

zh: 多试几次真有用。有研究让模型对 SWE-bench Lite 每题尝试 250 次，解决率从 15.9% 涨到 56%。
en: Repeated sampling pays off. With 250 attempts per issue, one study lifted SWE-bench Lite solves from 15.9% to 56%.

zh: OpenAI 的 SWE-Lancer 用了 1400 多个 Upwork 真实外包任务，报酬加起来 100 万美元，看 AI 能挣到多少。
en: OpenAI's SWE-Lancer uses 1,400+ real Upwork freelance tasks worth $1 million in total payouts to see how much AI could earn.

zh: LiveCodeBench 按发布日期持续收新题，结果发现有的模型老题分高、换新题就掉，明显是考前见过题。
en: LiveCodeBench keeps adding dated new problems. Some models ace old ones and drop on new ones, a clear sign they saw the test.

zh: 主流分词算法 BPE 原本是 1994 年的一种数据压缩算法，2015 年才被搬到神经机器翻译里用。
en: BPE, the tokenization method behind most LLMs, began as a 1994 data compression algorithm and was adapted for neural translation in 2015.

zh: Stack Overflow 2025 年调查里，开发者最大的烦恼是 AI 给的答案「几乎对，但不完全对」，66% 的人这么说。
en: In Stack Overflow's 2025 survey, developers' top AI frustration (66%) was solutions that are "almost right, but not quite."

zh: 2024 年 DORA 报告发现，AI 采用率每提高 25%，交付稳定性估计下降 7.2%。AI 让单个任务变快，不等于整体更稳。
en: The 2024 DORA report estimated a 25% rise in AI adoption came with a 7.2% drop in delivery stability. Faster isn't always steadier.

zh: Anthropic 做 SWE-bench 智能体时，花在打磨工具上的时间比打磨整体提示词还多。
en: Building its SWE-bench agent, Anthropic spent more time optimizing the tools than the overall prompt.

zh: τ-bench 用 pass^k 衡量稳定性：同一任务跑 k 次要次次都成功才算数。k 越大，分数掉得越狠。
en: τ-bench's pass^k measures reliability: a task counts only if all k runs succeed. Scores fall sharply as k grows.

zh: 「Vibe coding」出自 Karpathy 2025 年 2 月的一条推，意思是跟着感觉走、忘掉代码。不到一年就成了柯林斯年度词汇。
en: "Vibe coding" began as a Feb 2025 Karpathy tweet: follow the vibes, forget the code. Within a year it was Collins' word of the year.

zh: OpenAI 2022 年提出「填中间」训练：把空缺前后的内容都给模型，让它补上中间那块，比如写了一半的函数。
en: OpenAI's 2022 fill-in-the-middle training shows a model text before and after a gap to write the missing part, like a half-done function.

zh: 防呆设计：模型切换目录后老用错相对路径，Anthropic 就规定工具只收绝对路径，问题直接消失。
en: Poka-yoke your tools: the model kept botching relative paths, so Anthropic made the tool require absolute paths. Problem gone.

zh: Anthropic 实验发现，学新编程库时用 AI 帮忙的人，之后测验平均 50 分，自己写的组 67 分，调试题差得最多。
en: Anthropic found devs who used AI while learning a new library averaged 50% on a later quiz vs 67% hand-coding, worst on debugging.

zh: 微软、埃森哲等公司做的现场实验里，用上 AI 编程助手的开发者完成的任务多了约 26%，新手受益更大。
en: Field experiments at Microsoft, Accenture and another firm found AI coding assistants raised completed tasks about 26%, more for juniors.

zh: 投机解码：让小模型先猜几个 token，大模型一次性批改。输出分布不变，速度能快 2 到 3 倍。
en: Speculative decoding: a small model drafts tokens and the big model checks them in one pass. Same outputs, 2-3x faster.

zh: Anthropic 拿 SWE-bench 时用的脚手架很简单：一个提示词，加上一个 bash 工具和一个编辑工具。
en: Anthropic's SWE-bench scaffold was minimal: one prompt, a bash tool and a file-editing tool.

zh: 评测分数也会被机器配置影响。Anthropic 发现，同一个智能体编程评测，光是资源配置不同就能差 6 个百分点。
en: Benchmarks feel the hardware. Anthropic found infrastructure settings alone could swing an agentic coding eval by 6 points.

zh: Terminal-Bench 让智能体在终端沙箱里完成真实任务，比如编译代码、训模型、搭服务器，每题配测试脚本判分。
en: Terminal-Bench gives agents real tasks in a terminal sandbox, like compiling code, training models or setting up servers, graded by tests.

zh: Anthropic 招性能工程师的 2 小时笔试，Claude Opus 4.5 考赢了历来所有人类候选人，团队只好重新出题。
en: Claude Opus 4.5 beat every human candidate on Anthropic's 2-hour performance engineering take-home, so the team had to redesign it.

zh: Simon Willison 说：AI 写的代码你读过、测过、还能给别人讲明白，那就不叫 vibe coding，叫软件开发。
en: Simon Willison: if an LLM wrote your code but you reviewed, tested and can explain it, that's not vibe coding, it's software development.

zh: 结构化输出靠「约束解码」：生成时直接屏蔽不合规的 token，所以输出能 100% 符合你给的 JSON Schema。
en: Structured outputs use constrained decoding: tokens that would break your JSON Schema are blocked, so output always matches it.

zh: 给智能体写工具说明，就当是给新来的同事写文档：把你脑子里默认的背景知识都写清楚。
en: Write tool descriptions as if onboarding a new teammate: spell out the context you'd otherwise take for granted.

zh: 2025 年 Karpathy 力挺「上下文工程」：真正的功夫，是往上下文里刚好装进下一步需要的信息。
en: In 2025 Karpathy backed "context engineering": the real skill is filling the context with exactly what the next step needs.

zh: Claude 看图按 28×28 像素一小块算一个 token。一张 1000×1000 的图大约是 1296 个 token。
en: Claude sees images in 28×28-pixel patches, one token each. A 1000×1000 image costs about 1,296 tokens.

zh: 工具返回结果时，用人能读懂的名字代替一长串 UUID，智能体更不容易认错、编错。
en: Have tools return human-readable names instead of cryptic UUIDs. Agents make fewer mistakes and hallucinate less.

zh: 上下文里混进隐蔽 bug 时，代码模型往往会照着写出同样有问题的代码，模型越大越会模仿。
en: When the context contains subtle bugs, code models tend to write equally buggy code, and bigger models imitate more.

zh: Anthropic 让 16 个 Claude 并行协作，从零用 Rust 写了个 C 编译器，能编译 Linux 内核。
en: Anthropic had 16 Claude instances work in parallel to write a C compiler from scratch in Rust that can compile the Linux kernel.

zh: Claude 的新模型用「自适应思考」：模型自己判断要想多久，你用 effort 参数调它更省还是更认真。
en: Newer Claude models use adaptive thinking: the model decides how much to think, and the effort setting steers that.

zh: 从最简单的方案开始。Anthropic 的建议是：一次调用加检索和示例够用，就别急着上智能体。
en: Start simple. Anthropic advises that if one LLM call with retrieval and examples does the job, don't reach for an agent.

zh: Jason Wei 提出「验证者定律」：一件事越容易验证对错，AI 就越快学会它。编程正好是容易验证的。
en: Jason Wei's "verifier's law": the easier a task is to verify, the sooner AI will master it. Code is easy to check.

zh: 2026 年 4 月的 Claude Mythos Preview 强到 Anthropic 不敢公开发布；两个月后的 Fable 5 才是能安全公开的 Mythos 级模型。
en: Claude Mythos Preview (Apr 2026) was too capable to release. Fable 5, two months later, was the first Mythos-class model safe to ship.

zh: Anthropic 的上下文管理三板斧：压缩（把旧对话总结掉）、结构化笔记（写到窗口外）、子智能体（分头干活交摘要）。
en: Anthropic's long-task context tools: compaction (summarize old turns), structured notes (saved outside the window) and sub-agents.

zh: 长任务的交接秘诀：让智能体维护进度文件和 git 提交记录，下一个新会话读完就能接着干。
en: For long tasks, have the agent keep a progress file and git commits, so a fresh session can read them and pick up the work.

zh: 2025 年安全研究人员演示过：在 AI 编程工具的规则文件里藏看不见的 Unicode 字符，能让 AI 悄悄往代码里塞恶意脚本。
en: In 2025 researchers showed invisible Unicode hidden in AI coding rules files can make the AI quietly slip malicious code in.

zh: Addy Osmani 的「70% 问题」：AI 能很快帮你做出 70%，剩下 30% 的边界情况和打磨才是真功夫。
en: Addy Osmani's "70% problem": AI gets you 70% of the way fast; the last 30%, edge cases and polish, is the hard part.

zh: METR 的 RE-Bench 发现：给 2 小时，AI 智能体比人类专家做得好；给到 8 小时以上，人类反超。
en: METR's RE-Bench found AI agents beat human experts with a 2-hour budget, but humans pulled ahead at 8+ hours.

zh: 早期 AI 补全工具 Kite 2022 年宣布告别，创始人复盘说：我们早了十多年，技术还没准备好。
en: Kite, an early AI code-completion startup, said farewell in 2022. Its founder said they were 10+ years too early: the tech wasn't ready.

zh: 「即时上下文」：不把所有文件预先塞进去，只留文件路径这类线索，需要时让智能体自己去读。
en: "Just in time" context: instead of preloading files, keep lightweight references like paths and let the agent load them when needed.

zh: Anthropic 让智能体用 JSON 记功能清单而不是 Markdown，因为模型更少乱改 JSON 文件。
en: Anthropic kept the agent's feature list in JSON, not Markdown, because models are less likely to inappropriately edit JSON.

zh: Invariant Labs 演示过：在公开仓库发一个恶意 issue，读到它的智能体就可能把私有仓库的数据泄露出去。
en: Invariant Labs showed a malicious issue in a public repo could trick an agent reading it into leaking private repo data.

zh: 从 4.6 这一代开始，Claude 的模型 ID 不再带日期，比如 claude-opus-5-5，但每个 ID 仍固定指向同一个快照。
en: From the 4.6 generation on, Claude model IDs dropped the date, like claude-opus-5-5, yet each still pins one snapshot.

zh: 2023 年 DeepMind 的 AlphaDev 找到更快的短序列排序程序，并入了 LLVM 的 C++ 标准库，那块代码十多年没动过。
en: In 2023 DeepMind's AlphaDev found faster short-sequence sorting routines, merged into LLVM's libc++, code untouched for over a decade.

zh: 2025 年 8 月一起 npm 供应链攻击里，恶意代码会调用电脑上装好的 AI 命令行工具，让 AI 帮它翻找敏感数据。
en: In an Aug 2025 npm supply chain attack, malware tried to use locally installed AI CLIs to help it hunt for sensitive data.

zh: 2026 年 9 月发布的 Claude Opus 5.5，官方称多数任务达到 Fable 5.1 的水平，运行成本比 Opus 5 低 40%。
en: Claude Opus 5.5 (Sept 2026) matches Claude Fable 5.1 on most work, Anthropic says, and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5.

zh: DeepMind 的 AlphaEvolve 改进了 1969 年的 Strassen 矩阵乘法，还给谷歌数据中心找到条调度规则，收回约 0.7% 算力。
en: DeepMind's AlphaEvolve beat a 1969 Strassen matrix trick and found a Google data center scheduling rule that recovered ~0.7% of compute.

zh: 「上下文腐烂」：Chroma 测了 18 个模型，输入越长，表现越差，哪怕是很简单的任务。
en: "Context rot": Chroma tested 18 models and found performance drops as input gets longer, even on simple tasks.

zh: Airbnb 用大模型把近 3500 个 React 测试文件从 Enzyme 迁到 RTL，6 周干完，原本估计要一年半。
en: Airbnb used LLMs to migrate nearly 3,500 React test files from Enzyme to RTL in 6 weeks, a job estimated at 1.5 years.

zh: Advent of Code 的 FAQ 直说别用 AI 解题；办到第 10 年后，作者干脆取消了全球排行榜。
en: Advent of Code's FAQ says don't use AI to solve the puzzles, and after ten years its creator removed the global leaderboard.

zh: 截至 2026 年 10 月，Claude Fable 5.1、Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 的上下文都是 100 万 token，单次最多输出 12.8 万 token。
en: As of Oct 2026, Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 all have 1M-token context and can output up to 128K tokens at once.

zh: 「迷失在中间」：2023 年研究发现，关键信息放在长上下文的开头或结尾，模型用得最好；放中间最容易被忽略。
en: "Lost in the middle" (2023): models use information best at the start or end of a long context and worst in the middle.

zh: curl 维护者 Daniel Stenberg 多次吐槽 AI 生成的假漏洞报告太耗人力，curl 漏洞赏金于 2026 年 1 月底停止。
en: curl's Daniel Stenberg repeatedly flagged AI-generated bogus bug reports; curl's bug bounty ended at the end of January 2026.

zh: Anthropic 的「宪法 AI」让模型按一套成文原则自我批改。2023 年公布的那版原则里，连苹果的服务条款都有。
en: Anthropic's Constitutional AI has models critique themselves against written principles. The 2023 set even drew on Apple's terms.

zh: 2025 年 ICPC 全球总决赛，Gemini 2.5 Deep Think 做对 12 题里的 10 题，其中一题所有人类队伍都没做出来。
en: At the 2025 ICPC World Finals, Gemini 2.5 Deep Think solved 10 of 12 problems, including one that no human team solved.

zh: 「大海捞针」测试在长文本里藏一句无关的话让模型找。Claude 3 Opus 找到后还补了句：这像是有人故意塞来测我的。
en: Needle-in-a-haystack tests hide one odd sentence in a long text. Claude 3 Opus found it and added it looked planted to test it.

zh: 2025 年 7 月 AtCoder 世界巡回赛启发式决赛，10 小时比拼里人类选手 Psyho 赢了 OpenAI 的模型，AI 拿第二。
en: At AtCoder's 2025 World Tour Finals (Heuristic), human coder Psyho beat OpenAI's model over 10 hours; the AI placed second.

zh: 自洽性方法：同一题让模型用不同思路做很多遍，再投票选最多的答案，往往比只做一遍准。
en: Self-consistency: sample many different reasoning paths for one question and take the majority answer. It usually beats a single try.

zh: 亚马逊用 AI 助手升级 Java 应用，单个应用从约 50 人天缩到几小时，Andy Jassy 说相当于省下 4500 个开发者年。
en: Amazon's AI assistant cut Java upgrades from ~50 developer-days to a few hours per app. Andy Jassy estimated 4,500 developer-years saved.

zh: 2024 年 5 月 Anthropic 调高了 Claude 内部的「金门大桥」特征，那一版 Claude 三句不离大桥，问它长啥样，它说自己像金门大桥。
en: In May 2024 Anthropic dialed up a Golden Gate Bridge feature in Claude. It brought up the bridge nonstop, even saying it looked like one.

zh: 新一代 Claude 能同时发起多个工具调用，比如一次读好几个文件。在提示里鼓励一句，效率高不少。
en: Newer Claude models can make several tool calls at once, like reading multiple files. A nudge in the prompt boosts this.

zh: 「致命三要素」：智能体同时能读私密数据、会接触不可信内容、又能往外发消息，就可能被诱导泄密。
en: The "lethal trifecta": an agent with private data, exposure to untrusted content and a way to send data out can be tricked into leaking.

zh: 2022 年的 ReAct 论文让模型「想一步、做一步、看结果」交替进行，这就是今天智能体循环的雏形。
en: The 2022 ReAct paper had models interleave reasoning and actions, then observe results: the seed of today's agent loop.

zh: LLMflation：a16z 测算，达到同等能力的大模型推理成本，大约每年降到原来的十分之一。
en: "LLMflation": a16z estimated the cost of LLM inference at a fixed capability level falls about 10x every year.

zh: 中途发现方向不对就早点打断纠正，比等它写完一大坨再返工划算得多。
en: Course-correct early. Interrupting when the AI heads the wrong way beats reworking a big finished change.

zh: 给 AI 的指令越具体，第一次就做对的概率越高。「给 foo.py 加测试」不如「给 foo.py 写一个覆盖用户登出边界情况的测试，别用 mock」。
en: Specific instructions win. "Add tests for foo.py" < "test the logged-out edge case in foo.py, avoid mocks."

zh: 微软 2016 年推出语言服务器协议 LSP，把「M 个编辑器 × N 种语言」的适配变成 M + N。MCP 借鉴了这个思路。
en: Microsoft's 2016 Language Server Protocol turned M editors × N languages into M + N integrations. MCP borrowed the idea.

zh: 让智能体写代码去调工具，而不是一个个直接调，Anthropic 的例子里 token 从 15 万降到 2000，省了 98.7%。
en: Having agents write code to call tools instead of calling them directly cut one Anthropic example from 150,000 tokens to 2,000.

zh: Kent Beck 把 AI 编程智能体比作「难以捉摸的精灵」：会实现你的愿望，但常常是用意想不到的方式。
en: Kent Beck calls AI coding agents an unpredictable genie: it grants your wishes, but often in unexpected ways.

zh: Anthropic 的多智能体研究系统比单智能体强 90.2%，代价是约 15 倍 token。他们也说编程任务没那么适合并行。
en: Anthropic's multi-agent research system beat a single agent by 90.2% but burned ~15x the tokens. Coding parallelizes less well, they say.

zh: 早期测试时，Stripe 反馈说 Claude Fable 5 把好几个月的工程量压缩到了几天。
en: In early testing, Stripe reported that Claude Fable 5 compressed months of engineering work into days.

zh: 工具不是越多越好。Anthropic 建议少做几个精心设计、贴合真实任务的工具，别把每个 API 都包一层。
en: More tools isn't better. Anthropic advises a few thoughtful tools for real workflows rather than wrapping every API endpoint.

zh: 2026 年 9 月 1 日发布的 Claude Fable 5.1，输入输出价格和 Fable 5 一样，缓存读取只要原来的四分之一。
en: Claude Fable 5.1 (Sept 1, 2026) kept Fable 5's input and output prices but cut cache reads to a quarter of the cost.

zh: llms.txt 是 Jeremy Howard 2024 年提出的约定：在网站根目录放一份写给大模型读的 Markdown 简介。
en: llms.txt, proposed by Jeremy Howard in 2024, is a convention: a Markdown file at a website's root written for LLMs to read.

zh: Embedding 把一段文字变成一串数字，意思相近的离得近，RAG 靠它找资料。Anthropic 自己不做，推荐用 Voyage AI。
en: Embeddings turn text into numbers so similar meanings sit close together; RAG uses them to find material. Anthropic suggests Voyage AI.

zh: 2026 年 9 月底发布的 Claude Sonnet 5.5，每百万 token 输入 2 美元、输出 10 美元。
en: Claude Sonnet 5.5, released in late Sept 2026, costs $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.

zh: 「提示注入」这个词是 Simon Willison 2022 年 9 月起的，借用了「SQL 注入」的说法。
en: Simon Willison coined "prompt injection" in September 2022, borrowing from the name of SQL injection.

zh: 「RAG」出自 2020 年 Facebook AI 等机构的论文。一作后来说，早知道会这么火，当初就好好起个名字了。
en: "RAG" comes from a 2020 Facebook AI paper. The lead author later said he'd have picked a better name had he known it would catch on.

zh: 不急着要结果？Claude 的消息批处理 API 一批最多 1 万条请求，价格打五折。
en: Not in a hurry? Claude's Message Batches API takes up to 10,000 requests per batch at half price.

zh: 2022 年一篇论文发现，只要在问题后加一句「让我们一步步想」，模型在 MultiArith 上的准确率从 17.7% 升到 78.7%。
en: A 2022 paper found that adding "Let's think step by step" lifted accuracy on MultiArith from 17.7% to 78.7%.

zh: 2024 年 9 月 OpenAI 发布 o1：先在内部想一长段再作答，想得越久，结果往往越好。推理模型从这里走红。
en: OpenAI's o1 (Sept 2024) thinks at length before answering, and does better the longer it thinks. Reasoning models took off from there.

zh: Simon Willison 从 2024 年起用「SVG 画鹈鹕骑自行车」测新模型。头一年画得好坏跟模型强弱挺对得上，现在他说基本不准了。
en: Simon Willison tests models with an SVG pelican on a bicycle. Early on it tracked model quality; now he says it mostly doesn't.

zh: 装 Codex CLI：npm install -g @openai/codex，或者 brew install --cask codex。macOS 和 Linux 也能用官方的 curl 安装脚本。
en: Install Codex CLI with npm install -g @openai/codex or brew install --cask codex. macOS and Linux also get an official curl install script.

zh: Codex CLI 里它正在干活时，按 Enter 是把新指令插进当前这一轮，按 Tab 是排队，等这轮结束再发。
en: In Codex CLI, while it's working: Enter injects your message into the current turn, Tab queues it for the next one.

zh: Codex CLI 输入框为空时连按两下 Esc，可以改上一条消息，并从那里分叉出一个新对话。
en: In Codex CLI, press Esc twice on an empty composer to edit your previous message and fork the chat from that point.

zh: Codex CLI 里 Ctrl+O 是复制最近一条完整回答，跟 /copy 一样。从 Claude Code 过来的别按习惯按错了。
en: In Codex CLI, Ctrl+O copies the latest completed answer, same as /copy. Coming from Claude Code? It's not the transcript view.

zh: Codex CLI 写长 prompt 时按 Ctrl+G，会打开 VISUAL 或 EDITOR 指定的编辑器，保存关掉就回到输入框。
en: Writing a long prompt in Codex CLI? Ctrl+G opens your $VISUAL or $EDITOR; save and close to drop the text back in the composer.

zh: Codex CLI 的 /side（也能打 /btw）开一个临时的旁支对话，问完回主线，主对话的记录一点不受影响。
en: Codex CLI's /side (alias /btw) opens a throwaway side chat. Ask your detour question; the main chat's transcript stays untouched.

zh: Codex 的 /goal 给对话挂一个持续目标，比如「迁移完且测试全绿」。上限 4000 字符，更长的写进文件让它去读。
en: Codex's /goal pins a persistent target to the chat, like 'finish the migration, keep tests green'. Max 4,000 chars; longer goes in a file.

zh: Codex CLI 的 /review 审你工作区里的改动，重点看行为变化和漏写的测试。想换个模型审，在 config.toml 设 review_model。
en: Codex CLI's /review checks your working tree, focusing on behavior changes and missing tests. Set review_model to use another model.

zh: Codex 里 /status 一次看清当前模型、审批策略、可写目录和剩余上下文。怀疑它跑错了地方，先敲这个。
en: In Codex, /status shows the active model, approval policy, writable roots and remaining context. Check it when things feel off.

zh: Codex 的 /fast 打开当前模型的 Fast 档，再敲一次关掉。用订阅额度时按标准速率的 2.5 倍扣，快是要花钱的。
en: Codex's /fast toggles the current model's Fast tier. On subscription limits it burns usage at 2.5x the Standard rate.

zh: Codex CLI 的 /import 能把 Claude Code 或 Cursor 的配置、项目文件，连同最近 30 天里最多 50 个对话一起搬过来。
en: Codex CLI's /import pulls in Claude Code or Cursor setup, project files, and up to 50 chats from the last 30 days.

zh: Codex CLI 里敲 /pets，能在终端养一只宠物陪你写代码，内置的、自定义的都行，/pets off 就收起来。
en: Type /pets in Codex CLI to get an ambient terminal pet, built-in or custom. /pets off hides it.

zh: Codex 的 config.toml 明明改了却不生效？敲 /debug-config，它按优先级列出每一层配置和策略来源。
en: Changed config.toml but Codex ignores it? /debug-config prints every config layer in precedence order plus policy sources.

zh: 命令行里 codex resume --last 默认只找当前目录最近的会话，加上 --all 才会跨所有目录去找。
en: codex resume --last only looks at sessions from the current directory. Add --all to search across every directory.

zh: Codex 的 /archive 只是把会话从列表里收起来，codex unarchive 能找回；/delete 才是真删，派生的子会话也一起没了。
en: Codex's /archive just hides a session (codex unarchive brings it back). /delete is permanent and also removes descendant sessions.

zh: codex exec 运行时进度打到 stderr，stdout 只留最后一条回答，后面直接接 | tee notes.md 就能存下来。
en: codex exec streams progress to stderr and prints only the final answer to stdout, so | tee notes.md captures just the result.

zh: codex exec 能接管道：npm test 2>&1 | codex exec "总结失败原因"，管道内容当上下文，引号里的才是指令。
en: Pipe into codex exec: npm test 2>&1 | codex exec "summarize the failures". Piped text is context; the quoted prompt is the instruction.

zh: codex exec 默认在只读沙箱里跑，改不了文件。要它动手得加 --sandbox workspace-write，老的 --full-auto 已经废弃。
en: codex exec runs read-only by default. Add --sandbox workspace-write to let it edit; the old --full-auto flag is deprecated.

zh: codex exec --output-schema schema.json 让最终回答符合你给的 JSON Schema，再加 -o 文件名，结果直接落盘。
en: codex exec --output-schema schema.json forces the final answer to match your JSON Schema; add -o file.json to save it.

zh: codex exec --json 把 stdout 变成 JSONL 事件流，thread.started、turn.completed 一行一个，接 jq 就能解析。
en: codex exec --json turns stdout into a JSONL event stream (thread.started, turn.completed...), one per line, ready for jq.

zh: 两步流水线这样写：先 codex exec "找出竞态问题"，再 codex exec resume --last "把它们修掉"，接着上一步的上下文干。
en: Two-stage pipeline: codex exec "find race conditions", then codex exec resume --last "fix them" to continue with the same context.

zh: codex exec 默认必须在 Git 仓库里跑，防止误改出事。确定环境安全的话，加 --skip-git-repo-check 跳过这道检查。
en: codex exec refuses to run outside a Git repo to prevent destructive changes. Sure it's safe? Add --skip-git-repo-check.

zh: CI 里别把 OPENAI_API_KEY 设成整个 job 的环境变量，构建脚本、依赖钩子都读得到。GitHub 上直接用 openai/codex-action。
en: In CI, don't set OPENAI_API_KEY job-wide: build scripts and dependency hooks can read it. On GitHub, use openai/codex-action.

zh: GitHub PR 评论里写 @codex review，Codex 先点个眼睛表情，再发一份审查，而且只标 P0、P1 级别的问题。
en: Comment @codex review on a GitHub PR: Codex reacts with eyes, then posts a review flagging only P0 and P1 issues.

zh: Codex 审完 PR，再评论一句 @codex fix the P1 issue，它会开个云端任务去修，有权限的话直接推回这个分支。
en: After Codex reviews a PR, comment @codex fix the P1 issue. It starts a cloud task and can push the fix back to the branch.

zh: 想让 Codex 审 PR 时盯住你们自己的坑？在 AGENTS.md 里加一节 ## Code Review Rules，放在离那块代码最近的那份里。
en: Want Codex reviews to catch your team's pitfalls? Add a ## Code Review Rules section to the AGENTS.md closest to that code.

zh: Codex 从项目根一路走到当前目录找 AGENTS.md，每层最多读一个，依次拼起来，越靠近当前目录的越靠后、越说了算。
en: Codex walks from the project root to your cwd, taking at most one AGENTS.md per directory. Files closer to cwd come later and win.

zh: Codex 里同一目录的 AGENTS.override.md 比 AGENTS.md 优先。想临时换套全局规矩又不删原文件，在 ~/.codex 放一个 override。
en: In Codex, AGENTS.override.md beats AGENTS.md in the same folder. Drop one in ~/.codex to override global rules without deleting them.

zh: Codex 读进来的 AGENTS.md 合计默认只有 32 KiB，超出就不再往里加。写太长就调大 project_doc_max_bytes，或拆到子目录。
en: Codex caps combined AGENTS.md guidance at 32 KiB by default. Raise project_doc_max_bytes or split rules across nested folders.

zh: 仓库里已经有 TEAM_GUIDE.md？把它加进 project_doc_fallback_filenames，没有 AGENTS.md 的目录里 Codex 就会读它。
en: Already have TEAM_GUIDE.md? Add it to project_doc_fallback_filenames and Codex reads it wherever AGENTS.md is missing.

zh: Codex 沙箱分三档：read-only 只看不改；workspace-write 能在工作区里改文件、跑命令，本地默认就是它；danger-full-access 不设限。
en: Codex sandboxes: read-only just looks; workspace-write (local default) edits and runs commands there; danger-full-access has no limits.

zh: Codex 不再支持 approval_policy = "untrusted"，留着可能直接起不来。想要原来的严格审批，改给项目设 trust_level = "untrusted"。
en: Codex dropped approval_policy = "untrusted" and may not start with it. For that strictness, set the project's trust_level = "untrusted".

zh: Codex 默认的 workspace-write 也不让命令联网。要放开，在 config.toml 的 [sandbox_workspace_write] 下写 network_access = true。
en: Codex's default workspace-write sandbox keeps commands offline. To allow network, set network_access = true under [sandbox_workspace_write].

zh: Codex 就算在 workspace-write 模式，工作区里的 .git 也是只读的，存在的 .codex、.agents 目录同样改不了。
en: Even in workspace-write, Codex can't modify .git in a writable root, and existing .codex and .agents folders are read-only too.

zh: Codex 的沙箱在 macOS 上用系统自带的 Seatbelt，在 Linux 上用 bwrap 加 seccomp。Linux 用户记得先装 bubblewrap。
en: Codex sandboxes with Seatbelt on macOS and bwrap plus seccomp on Linux. On Linux, install bubblewrap first.

zh: Codex 的 --yolo 就是 --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox：没沙箱，也不审批。官方只建议在专门隔离的虚拟机里用。
en: Codex's --yolo is short for --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox: no sandbox, no approvals. Only use it inside a dedicated sandbox VM.

zh: Codex 可以让另一个审查 agent 替你点头：approvals_reviewer = "auto_review"。它不扩大任何权限，只是换了谁来批。
en: Codex can let a reviewer agent approve for you: approvals_reviewer = "auto_review". It grants no extra access, it just swaps who approves.

zh: Codex 的自动审查带熔断：一轮里连续拒 3 次，或最近 50 次审查里拒了 10 次，就直接中断这一轮，免得 agent 绕着圈硬闯。
en: Codex auto-review has a circuit breaker: 3 denials in a row, or 10 in the last 50 reviews of a turn, and the turn is aborted.

zh: 自动审查拒了，但你确定没事？Codex CLI 里 /approve 选一条被拒的操作，给它一次重试机会，只限那一条，重试照样要过审。
en: Auto-review denied something you know is fine? In Codex CLI, /approve grants one retry of exactly that action; the retry is still reviewed.

zh: Codex 的 rules 用 Starlark 写，prefix_rule 按命令前缀判 allow、prompt 或 forbidden，多条命中时取最严的那个。
en: Codex rules are written in Starlark: prefix_rule matches a command prefix as allow, prompt or forbidden. The strictest match wins.

zh: 在 Codex 规则里放行了 git add，git add . && rm -rf / 也不会跟着过：这种串联命令会被拆开，逐条过规则。
en: Allowing git add in Codex rules won't let git add . && rm -rf / through: chained commands are split and each one is checked.

zh: Codex 的 profile 现在是单独的文件 ~/.codex/名字.config.toml，用 codex --profile 名字 叠上去。0.134.0 起不再认 [profiles.x] 写法。
en: Codex profiles are now files: ~/.codex/NAME.config.toml, loaded via --profile NAME. Since 0.134.0, [profiles.x] tables are ignored.

zh: 临时改 Codex 配置不用动文件：codex -c sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=true，值按 TOML 解析，只管这一次。
en: Override Codex config for one run without editing files: codex -c sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=true. Values parse as TOML.

zh: Codex 配置谁说了算：命令行参数 > 项目 .codex/config.toml > profile > ~/.codex/config.toml。项目配置只在信任的项目里加载。
en: Codex config precedence: CLI flags > project .codex/config.toml > profile > ~/.codex/config.toml. Project config loads only if trusted.

zh: Codex 默认不滤带 KEY、SECRET、TOKEN 的环境变量，子命令都读得到。设 shell_environment_policy.ignore_default_excludes = false 才滤。
en: Codex passes *KEY*/*SECRET*/*TOKEN* env vars to commands by default. shell_environment_policy.ignore_default_excludes = false drops them.

zh: Codex 的 notify 配置能在每轮结束时调用你的脚本，把一段 JSON 当参数传进去，接桌面通知、发 webhook 都行。
en: Codex's notify setting runs your script when a turn completes, passing one JSON argument. Great for desktop toasts or webhooks.

zh: Codex 默认搜网走 OpenAI 维护的缓存索引，不现抓网页，少吃提示注入。要实时结果就加 --search。
en: Codex web search defaults to an OpenAI-maintained cache, not live pages, to reduce prompt injection. Use --search for live results.

zh: Codex 里设 file_opener = "vscode"（或 cursor、windsurf），回答里的 文件:行号 就变成能点的链接，一点跳进编辑器。
en: Set file_opener = "vscode" (or cursor, windsurf) and Codex turns file:line citations into clickable links into your editor.

zh: codex mcp add context7 -- npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp，一行给 Codex 接上文档 MCP，CLI、IDE 和桌面端共用这份配置。
en: codex mcp add context7 -- npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp adds a docs MCP server in one line. CLI, IDE and desktop app share it.

zh: 给 Codex 的 MCP 服务器加上 required = true，它起不来时直接报错，不会悄悄少个工具接着跑，codex exec 也会退出。
en: Mark a Codex MCP server required = true and startup fails if it can't initialize, instead of silently running without it.

zh: Codex 自带 default、worker、explorer 三个子 agent。自定义的写成 TOML 放 ~/.codex/agents/ 或项目 .codex/agents/，同名会顶掉内置的。
en: Codex ships default, worker and explorer subagents. Add your own as TOML in ~/.codex/agents/ or .codex/agents/; same name beats a built-in.

zh: Codex 的 hook 要你先审过、信任了才会跑，信任按 hook 定义的哈希记，配置一改就得重新信任。到 /hooks 里管理。
en: Codex runs a hook only after you review and trust it. Trust is tied to the definition's hash, so edits need re-trust. Manage them in /hooks.

zh: Codex 开 Worktree 对话时，被 .gitignore 掉的 .env 不会跟过去。在仓库根放一个 .worktreeinclude 列出来，就会自动复制。
en: Codex worktree chats don't get your gitignored .env. List such files in a .worktreeinclude at the repo root and Codex copies them over.

zh: Codex Cloud 每个任务有自己的工作区，电脑睡着了也照样跑。但你本机的文件、VPN、浏览器登录态都不会带过去。
en: Each Codex Cloud task gets its own workspace and runs while your laptop sleeps. Local files, VPN and browser logins don't come along.

zh: 终端里 codex cloud exec 往云端派任务，codex cloud list --json 查状态，做完用 codex apply 把 diff 打回本地仓库。
en: From the terminal: codex cloud exec sends a task to the cloud, codex cloud list --json checks status, codex apply pulls the diff locally.

zh: Codex 的 IDE 扩展里，/local、/cloud、/worktree 决定这段对话在哪跑：本机、云端，还是新开的 Git worktree。
en: In the Codex IDE extension, /local, /cloud and /worktree choose where the chat runs: your workspace, the cloud, or a new Git worktree.

zh: 有了 Codex Remote，躺床上用手机 ChatGPT 就能给电脑上的 Codex 派活、批命令、看 diff。活在电脑上跑，记得让电脑开着别睡。
en: With Codex Remote, your phone's ChatGPT app can start tasks, approve commands and see diffs. Work runs on your computer, so keep it awake.

zh: Codex Micro 是 Codex 和 Work Louder 合作的限量小键盘：6 个 Agent 键各盯一个对话，亮琥珀色就是在等你批准。
en: Codex Micro is a limited-run keypad from Codex and Work Louder: six Agent Keys each track a chat, glowing amber when it needs you.
