zh: Codex CLI 最早是 TypeScript 写的，装之前得先有 Node 22。2025 年 5 月官方宣布用 Rust 重写，头一个理由就是零依赖安装。
en: Codex CLI began in TypeScript and needed Node 22+. In May 2025 OpenAI announced a Rust rewrite; reason one: zero-dependency install.

zh: 仓库里的 .codex/config.toml 改不了 Codex 的模型提供商、notify、otel 这些键，写了会被忽略并警告，防有人借仓库偷换凭据。
en: A repo's .codex/config.toml can't set model_provider, notify or otel. Codex ignores them with a warning so a repo can't redirect creds.

zh: 怀疑 Codex 没读到 AGENTS.md？codex debug prompt-input 会把模型实际看到的输入以 JSON 打出来，一查就知道。
en: Unsure Codex loaded your AGENTS.md? codex debug prompt-input prints the exact model-visible prompt input as JSON.

zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的口号是「一切皆插件」：模型适配器、工具注册表、会话日志，连 agent 循环本身都是插件，都能从配置里换掉。
en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) means it: model adapters, tool registry, session log, even the agent loop are plugins you can swap via config.

zh: 装了 Node 就能试 DSH：npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web，默认在 127.0.0.1:3080 打开 Web UI。加 --no-open 只起服务不开浏览器。
en: Try DSH with Node: npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web opens the Web UI on 127.0.0.1:3080. Add --no-open to skip launching the browser.

zh: 想知道 DSH 到底加载了啥？跑 dsh --profile web --dump-config 打印完整插件配置树，里面任何一项都能被你的 patch 替换。
en: Curious what DSH loads? dsh --profile web --dump-config prints the full plugin tree; any entry in it can be replaced by your own patch.

zh: DSH 新建任务有四种内置模式：标准、PTC、极简、创造。官方建议日常任务用标准，想扩展 DSH 自己就选创造模式。
en: DSH ships four built-in modes: Standard, PTC, Minimal and Creator. Use Standard for daily work and Creator to extend DSH itself.

zh: DSH 的 PTC 模式是「用程序调工具」：Agent 写一段 TypeScript 交给 run_code 跑，循环、筛选、汇总在代码里做完，只把结果交给模型。
en: DSH PTC mode is programmatic tool calling: the agent writes TypeScript for run_code, filters in code, and passes only results on.

zh: DSH 的极简模式只给 Agent 一个持久 Shell 和固定提示词，没有 Skills、计划和压缩。文档特意提醒：工具少不代表对新手更容易。
en: DSH Minimal mode gives the agent one persistent shell and a fixed prompt. The docs warn: fewer tools does not mean easier for beginners.

zh: DSH 的创造模式让你用聊天给 DSH 加功能，比如让 Agent 写个插件，在侧栏加「项目笔记」入口，装好并验证页面能打开。
en: DSH Creator mode adds features by chat: have the agent write a plugin adding a "Project notes" sidebar entry, install it, and verify it.

zh: 在 DSH 创造模式里说「基于标准模式建一个代码审查模式，改文件前先问我」，就能得到一个新建任务时可选的自定义模式。
en: In DSH Creator mode, say "make a code-review mode based on Standard that asks before editing" and you get a custom mode for new tasks.

zh: DSH 插件页「添加插件」菜单里有「让 Agent 创建插件」：直接进创造模式，草稿保留，发出需求后才开始干活。
en: DSH plugin page has "Let Agent create a plugin": it opens Creator mode, keeps your draft, and starts only after you send the request.

zh: DSH 装插件走 pnpm：dsh plugin --profile <名字> add <包>，参数在 profile 目录里原样转给 pnpm，所以 pnpm 子命令都能用。
en: DSH installs plugins via pnpm: dsh plugin --profile <name> add <pkg> forwards args to pnpm in the profile dir, so any pnpm subcommand works.

zh: DSH 第一次装插件时，若没指定安装源，会同时 ping npm 官方源和 npmmirror，谁先响应用谁；从 GitHub 装失败还会提示「改用国内镜像」。
en: First DSH plugin install, no registry set: it pings npm and npmmirror, takes the first to answer, and offers the mirror if GitHub fails.

zh: DSH 里输入 /plan 进计划模式，Agent 先探索设计、交计划给你批；不满意选 Keep planning 让它接着改，/plan off 退出。
en: In DSH, /plan makes the agent explore and submit a plan for approval; pick Keep planning to send it back, /plan off to leave.

zh: DSH 的计划模式不会禁用任何工具，只是引导 Agent 先规划。真想拦住改动，得靠沙箱模式和审批。
en: DSH plan mode does not disable any tool; it only guides the agent to plan first. To actually block changes, use sandbox mode and approvals.

zh: DSH 里 /goal <目标> 给会话挂一个持久目标，Agent 会一轮轮接着干；/goal pause 暂停，/goal resume 继续，/goal clear 清掉。
en: In DSH, /goal <objective> attaches a persistent goal the agent keeps working on; /goal pause, /goal resume and /goal clear control it.

zh: DSH 里输入 /compact 立刻压缩较早的对话，不消耗模型轮次，完成后告诉你压了几条、估计省了多少 token。它不接受参数。
en: DSH /compact summarizes older history right away without a model turn, then reports items replaced and estimated tokens saved. No arguments.

zh: DSH Web 里输入 /export，整个会话连同子会话和附件会打包成 dsh-session-<id>.zip 下载下来。
en: In DSH Web, /export downloads the whole session tree, child sessions and attachments included, as dsh-session-<id>.zip.

zh: DSH 里输入 /permission 切换当前会话权限：仅可查看、工作区内修改、完全权限。点选完全权限时会先让你确认风险。
en: In DSH, /permission switches this session between Read Only, Workspace Write and Full access; picking Full access asks you to confirm.

zh: DSH 里按 Cmd+/（Windows 用 Ctrl+/）打开快捷键速查，能搜操作名、英文别名或键位，点一行就能改键。
en: In DSH, Cmd+/ (Ctrl+/ on Windows) opens the shortcut sheet: search by action, alias or key, and click a row to rebind it.

zh: DSH 里想让 Agent 停下？在输入框连按两下 Esc 停止生成，两下的间隔默认不能超过 500 毫秒。
en: To stop the DSH agent, press Esc twice in the composer; by default the two presses must be within 500 ms.

zh: DSH 里 Agent 忙着时，Enter 和 Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 一个是排队发送、一个是插话发送，哪个归 Enter 在设置「繁忙时的发送行为」里选。
en: While the DSH agent is busy, Enter and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter split between Queue and Steer; choose which one Enter does in settings.

zh: DSH 桌面端：Cmd+N 新会话，Cmd+K 搜会话，Cmd+B 收左栏，Cmd+P 开文件，Ctrl+` 开终端。Windows 用 Ctrl，Web 版多数再加 Alt。
en: DSH Desktop: Cmd+N new session, Cmd+K search, Cmd+B sidebar, Cmd+P files, Ctrl+` terminal. Ctrl on Windows; Web adds Alt to most.

zh: DSH 桌面端按 Cmd+Alt+F 把当前会话分叉一份，Cmd+Alt+G 重命名，Cmd+Shift+A 归档。Windows 把 Cmd 换成 Ctrl。
en: DSH Desktop: Cmd+Alt+F forks the current session, Cmd+Alt+G renames it, Cmd+Shift+A archives it. Use Ctrl instead of Cmd on Windows.

zh: DSH 的 Windows 和 macOS 桌面端能录「双键」快捷键：两个普通键同时按住，比如 F G，还能配修饰键。先后按 A、B 只会录成 A。
en: DSH Desktop on Windows and macOS can bind two keys held together, like F G, plus modifiers. Pressing A then B only records A.

zh: DSH 桌面端关掉主窗口只是隐藏，任务照跑，会话和草稿都在。macOS 点 Dock 图标找回，Windows 从托盘找回。
en: Closing the DSH Desktop window only hides it: tasks keep running, drafts stay. Reopen via the Dock on macOS or the tray on Windows.

zh: DSH 桌面端菜单里的「管理 dsh 命令…」能把 dsh 装进终端，不用另装 Node 或 pnpm。装完开个新终端跑 dsh --version 验一下。
en: DSH Desktop menu "Manage dsh command" installs dsh for your terminal, no separate Node or pnpm. Open a new terminal and run dsh --version.

zh: 在 DSH 里直接说「每天 Asia/Shanghai 时区 23:00 提醒我查看天气」，Agent 用 schedule_create 建好提醒，到点在原会话排一条消息。
en: Tell DSH "remind me to check the weather daily at 23:00 Asia/Shanghai" and schedule_create sets it up, queuing a message in that session.

zh: DSH 的提醒支持一次性、固定间隔（最短 1 分钟）、每天、每周，还能写带 IANA 时区的五字段 cron 表达式。
en: DSH reminders can be one-shot, fixed interval (1 minute minimum), daily, weekly, or a five-field cron with an IANA time zone.

zh: DSH 的定时提醒靠 Host 进程调度，关了 DSH 就不跑。重启后补发逾期的一次性提醒，重复任务只补最近错过的那一次。
en: DSH reminders run only while the host runs. After a restart, overdue one-shots are delivered; recurring ones get only the last missed run.

zh: DSH 的无头模式：dsh --profile headless "run the tests"，答案打到 stdout 就退出，成功退出码 0、失败 1，不开任何端口。
en: DSH headless: dsh --profile headless "run the tests" prints the answer to stdout and exits 0 on success, 1 on failure. No ports opened.

zh: DSH 无头模式加 --json 输出逐行 JSON 事件，开头的 session 事件带会话 id；下次用 --session-id 接着这段对话跑。
en: DSH headless --json streams line-delimited JSON events; the first session event carries the id, and --session-id resumes that conversation.

zh: DSH 无头模式不写任务参数就从 stdin 读，可以把「总结这些改动」连同 git diff --stat 一起管道进去当提示词。
en: DSH headless reads the task from stdin when no argument is given, so you can pipe a prompt plus git diff --stat straight in.

zh: DSH 会读项目里的 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md，外加全局的 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md。CLAUDE.md 要是只复制了 AGENTS.md，不会重复加载。
en: DSH reads project AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md plus global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md. A CLAUDE.md that just copies AGENTS.md is loaded only once.

zh: DSH 去这些地方找 Skill：项目的 .dsh/skills、.agents/skills，用户的 ~/.dsh/skills、~/.agents/skills。新增或改名都不用重启。
en: DSH finds skills in project .dsh/skills and .agents/skills, plus ~/.dsh/skills and ~/.agents/skills. Adding or renaming needs no restart.

zh: DSH 能直接跑你现有的 Claude Code hooks.json：挂上 dsh-hooks-claude-code，把 configPath 指过去，PreToolUse、Stop 等钩子照常触发。
en: DSH runs your existing Claude Code hooks.json: mount dsh-hooks-claude-code, set configPath, and PreToolUse, Stop and friends fire as usual.

zh: DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 加了实验性 Claude Code Mods 兼容层。官方说主要是验证 Mods API 大体是 DSH 插件能力的子集，不是提供完整兼容。
en: DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 added an experimental Claude Code Mods layer, mainly to show the Mods API is roughly a subset of DSH plugins.

zh: 在 DSH 里跑 Claude Code Mod 不带沙箱：钩子模块在进程内运行，有进程的全部权限，能读写环境变量、访问任意 URL。只挂信得过的。
en: Claude Code mods in DSH are not sandboxed: hook modules run in-process with full rights, env access and any URL. Only mount mods you trust.

zh: DSH 能把子任务派给真的 Claude Code 或 Codex：装上 dsh-subagent-claude-code 或 dsh-subagent-codex，配好委派工具，只拿回最终答案。
en: DSH can delegate to real Claude Code or Codex: install dsh-subagent-claude-code or dsh-subagent-codex, wire the tool, get the final answer.

zh: DSH 的实验性 Auto review 权限：工具调用前先让模型审，低风险放行，跨边界泄露敏感信息一律判拒，被拒的转来问你。默认关，去插件页开。
en: DSH experimental Auto review has the model vet each tool call: low risk runs, secret leaks are denied and sent to you. Off by default.

zh: DSH 的沙箱在 Linux 用 bwrap/Landlock，macOS 用 Seatbelt，Windows 用 ACL 受限令牌。它只管文件系统，网络和进程不归它管。
en: DSH sandboxing uses bwrap/Landlock on Linux, Seatbelt on macOS, restricted ACL tokens on Windows. It covers files only, not network.

zh: DSH 的安全说明很直白：还没做过安全审计，沙箱和审批不保证隔离。建议放在一次性虚拟机或容器里跑，并备份它能碰到的文件。
en: DSH SAFETY.md is blunt: no security audit yet, sandbox and approvals do not guarantee isolation. Run it in a throwaway VM or container.

zh: DSH 不读系统代理设置，Clash 的「系统代理」开关对它没用。要么导出 HTTPS_PROXY 和 HTTP_PROXY，要么开 TUN 模式。
en: DSH ignores OS proxy settings, so a "system proxy" toggle does nothing for it. Export HTTPS_PROXY and HTTP_PROXY, or use TUN mode.

zh: DSH 不支持 SOCKS 代理，socks5:// 会被跳过转直连；NO_PROXY 里写 10.0.0.0/8 这种网段也不生效，要写主机名或域名后缀。
en: DSH has no SOCKS support: socks5:// is skipped and goes direct. CIDR ranges in NO_PROXY do nothing; use host names or domain suffixes.

zh: DSH 的代理变量能写进 ~/.dsh/.env，但项目自己的 .env 不行：它随 git clone 而来，DSH 宁可拒绝启动，也不让仓库决定你的流量去向。
en: DSH proxy vars may go in ~/.dsh/.env but never a project .env: it arrives with git clone, so DSH refuses to start rather than obey it.

zh: DSH 的「设置 → 模型」能加第三方提供商，如 anthropic、openai、Kimi 的 moonshotai、GLM 的 zai；中转站就选「自定义模型 API」。
en: In DSH Settings > Models, add providers like anthropic, openai, moonshotai (Kimi) or zai (GLM); for a relay, choose Custom model API.

zh: DSH 自定义模型 API 支持三种协议：OpenAI Chat Completions、OpenAI Responses、Anthropic Messages。网关两种都给，就得建两个提供商。
en: DSH custom model APIs speak OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses or Anthropic Messages, one per provider; two protocols, two providers.

zh: DSH 里填的 API 密钥是只写的：保存后页面只拿到脱敏描述，永远看不到明文，密钥本身存在 $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml。
en: API keys in DSH are write-only: after saving, the page only gets a masked descriptor; the key itself lives in $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml.

zh: 在 DSH 创造模式里直接说「把某地址的 MCP 服务器配进当前 profile，命名 demo」，Agent 会装好，工具以 mcp__demo__ 开头出现。
en: In DSH Creator mode, ask the agent to add an MCP server named demo to the profile; it installs it and tools appear as mcp__demo__*.

zh: DSH 自带 GitHub webhook 示例：PR 从草稿变成 ready for review 时，自动开一个只读权限的评审会话，禁止改文件和 PR。
en: DSH ships a GitHub webhook example: when a PR goes from draft to ready for review, it opens a read-only review session.

zh: DSH 有 Python SDK：pip install deepseek-harness-sdk，安装包自带 dsh 命令和原生运行时，平时用不需要系统装 Node.js。
en: DSH has a Python SDK: pip install deepseek-harness-sdk bundles the dsh command and native runtime, so normal use needs no system Node.js.

zh: dsh web 默认只听本机，--host 0.0.0.0 会在启动时直接被拒。想远程访问，走反向代理，再用 --public-url 和 --trusted-host 配好。
en: dsh web listens on loopback only; --host 0.0.0.0 is rejected at startup. Remote access: reverse proxy plus --public-url and --trusted-host.

zh: DSH 的 Agent 用同样参数反复调同一个工具时，会在第 3、5、8 次被提醒换个办法。只是建议，不会拦着它。
en: When a DSH agent repeats the same tool call with identical args, it gets nudged at the 3rd, 5th and 8th repeat. Advice only, never a block.

zh: DSH 桌面端自带一套 Python，装好了 pandas、python-docx、python-pptx、openpyxl 等库，Office 任务默认就用它，不碰你的系统 Python。
en: DSH Desktop ships its own Python with pandas, python-docx, python-pptx, openpyxl and more; Office tasks use it by default.

zh: DSH 的 ralph 工具每轮都起一个全新 Agent，看不到之前的对话，只靠共享工作区和一份结构化报告接力。工具说明要求只在你明确点名时才用。
en: DSH ralph starts a fresh agent each round with no prior chat, relaying via the workspace and a short report. Used only when you ask for it.

zh: DSH 里可继续对话的子 Agent，默认最多同时活 8 个、委派深度 1 层。想调就去侧栏「插件」里的「子智能体」页。
en: DSH allows 8 live resumable subagents and delegation depth 1 by default. Change both on the Subagents page under Plugins in the sidebar.

zh: DSH 实验性的 Team 模式用 spawn_teammate 拉队友，默认最多建 16 个；任务看板是只读的，任务由 Agent 用工具更新。
en: DSH experimental Team mode adds teammates via spawn_teammate, up to 16 by default; the task board is read-only, agents update it via tools.

zh: DSH 底下的插件框架叫 Cordis，它的设计还写成了一篇论文：《A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability》。
en: DSH runs on the Cordis plugin framework, whose design has its own paper: "A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability".

zh: DSH 会给模型一只「时钟」：Web 版的标准、创造、PTC 模式会定期告诉它当前时间和浏览器时区，默认至少隔 10 分钟才更新一次。
en: DSH gives the model a clock: in Web, Standard, Creator and PTC modes feed it time and browser zone, at most every 10 min by default.

zh: DSH 有实验性语音输入，用本地 SenseVoice 模型识别。第一次用要下模型，会同时探测 Hugging Face 和 HF-Mirror，谁先响应从谁下。
en: DSH experimental voice input runs a local SenseVoice model. First use downloads it, probing Hugging Face and HF-Mirror, using the faster.

zh: DSH 可以在本机跑、通过 SSH 操作远端工作区：文件、命令、终端都指向远端，模型请求和会话存储留在本机。
en: DSH can run locally and work in a remote workspace over SSH: files, commands and terminals are remote; model calls and sessions stay local.

zh: DSH 的家目录 $DSH_HOME 默认是 ~/.dsh。dsh web 的配置在 ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml，设置页顶部「打开配置文件」直接打开。
en: $DSH_HOME defaults to ~/.dsh. dsh web config lives in ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml; "Open config file" in Settings opens it.

zh: Cursor 的 .cursor/rules 里只认 .mdc 文件，放个普通 .md 会被直接忽略。不想写 frontmatter，就改用根目录的 AGENTS.md。
en: Cursor's .cursor/rules only reads .mdc files; a plain .md there is silently ignored. Skip the frontmatter by using a root AGENTS.md instead.

zh: Cursor 聊天框输入 /create-rule 再说你要的规矩，Agent 会生成带好 frontmatter 的规则文件，直接存进 .cursor/rules。
en: Type /create-rule in Cursor and describe the rule you want; Agent writes the file with proper frontmatter and saves it to .cursor/rules.

zh: Cursor 的 .cursorignore 挡得住 Agent、Tab 和 @ 引用，却挡不住 Agent 跑的终端命令和 MCP 工具。真正的密钥别只靠它。
en: Cursor's .cursorignore blocks Agent, Tab and @-mentions, but not terminal commands or MCP tools. Don't rely on it alone for secrets.

zh: Cursor 默认就忽略 .env*、各种 lock 文件，连 *.csv 和 *.pdf 也在默认忽略名单里。想让它读，在 .cursorignore 里用 ! 放行。
en: Cursor ignores .env*, lock files, and even *.csv and *.pdf by default. To let it read them, un-ignore with ! in .cursorignore.

zh: Cursor 的 Bugbot 会自动审 PR，也能手动叫：在任意 PR 下评论 cursor review 或 bugbot run 就行。
en: Cursor's Bugbot reviews PRs automatically, or on demand: comment cursor review or bugbot run on any PR.

zh: Cursor Bugbot 只从目标分支读 .cursor/config/bugbot.yaml，不读 PR 里的版本。所以没有哪个 PR 能偷偷改掉 Bugbot 审自己的规矩。
en: Bugbot reads .cursor/config/bugbot.yaml from the PR's base branch, never the PR head, so a PR can't change how Bugbot reviews itself.

zh: Cursor CLI（命令是 agent）里，在消息前加个 &，就把这活儿交给云端 Cloud Agent 接着跑，你人走了它照样干。
en: In Cursor CLI (the agent command), prefix a message with & to hand the task to a Cloud Agent that keeps working while you're away.

zh: Cursor 编辑器里 Agent 干活时，按 Enter 是排队，等它做完手上的再处理；按 Cmd+Enter 立刻发出去，插进当前任务。
en: In the Cursor editor, while Agent works, Enter queues your message for later; Cmd+Enter sends it immediately into the current task.

zh: Cursor 的 Debug Mode 不急着改代码：先列几种假设、往代码里插日志，让你复现一遍，看完运行时证据再修，修完把日志全删掉。
en: Cursor's Debug Mode doesn't guess: it adds logs, has you reproduce the bug, fixes from runtime evidence, then removes the logs.

zh: Cursor 新建 worktree 时会跑 .cursor/worktrees.json 里的 setup-worktree，写上 npm ci 和拷 .env，每个 agent 开工前环境就齐了。
en: Cursor runs .cursor/worktrees.json when creating a worktree. Put npm ci and a .env copy in setup-worktree so each agent starts ready.

zh: Gemini CLI 的 GEMINI.md 分三层：~/.gemini 全局、项目目录，还有工具碰到某个子目录时才临时加载的。/memory show 看拼好的全文。
en: Gemini CLI loads GEMINI.md globally, per project, and just-in-time when a tool touches a subfolder. /memory show prints the combined text.

zh: 不想维护两套说明？Gemini CLI 的 settings.json 里把 context.fileName 设成 ["AGENTS.md", "GEMINI.md"]，就会连 AGENTS.md 一起读。
en: Tired of duplicate instruction files? Set context.fileName to ["AGENTS.md", "GEMINI.md"] in Gemini CLI's settings.json to read both.

zh: Gemini CLI 的 checkpointing 默认关着，在 settings.json 打开 general.checkpointing.enabled，改文件前就自动存快照，/restore 回滚。
en: Gemini CLI checkpointing is off by default. Enable general.checkpointing.enabled in settings.json, then use /restore to roll back AI edits.

zh: Gemini CLI 的文件快照存在 ~/.gemini/history 下一个「影子」Git 仓库里，和你项目自己的 Git 历史互不干扰。
en: Gemini CLI keeps checkpoint snapshots in a shadow Git repo under ~/.gemini/history, separate from your project's own Git history.

zh: Gemini CLI 里连按两下 Esc 打开 /rewind，可以只回退对话、只撤销代码，或两样一起退。注意它撤不掉你用 ! 跑命令改的文件。
en: Double-tap Esc in Gemini CLI for /rewind: revert the chat, the code, or both. It can't undo files changed by your own ! shell commands.

zh: Gemini CLI 的自定义命令是 TOML 文件：存成 .gemini/commands/git/commit.toml 就变成 /git:commit，prompt 里写 {{args}} 接参数。
en: Gemini CLI custom commands are TOML files: .gemini/commands/git/commit.toml becomes /git:commit, and {{args}} in the prompt takes arguments.

zh: Gemini CLI 里打 @src/ 能把整个目录塞进上下文，默认自动跳过 .gitignore 里的东西，比如 node_modules 和 .env。
en: In Gemini CLI, @src/ pulls a whole directory into context, skipping git-ignored files like node_modules and .env by default.

zh: Gemini CLI 加 -s 启动就进沙箱。macOS 可用系统自带的 Seatbelt，默认配置只许写项目目录；也能设 GEMINI_SANDBOX=docker 换容器。
en: Start Gemini CLI with -s to sandbox it. On macOS, Seatbelt's default profile only allows project writes; or set GEMINI_SANDBOX=docker.

zh: 用 Google 账号登录 Gemini CLI，免费每天 1000 次请求；换成不付费的 Gemini API key 只有 250 次，而且只能用 Flash 模型。
en: Gemini CLI with a Google login gets 1,000 free requests a day; an unpaid Gemini API key gets just 250, Flash models only.

zh: Gemini CLI 里跑的 shell 命令，不管是模型调的还是你用 ! 敲的，都带环境变量 GEMINI_CLI=1，脚本靠它就知道自己在 Gemini CLI 里。
en: Shell commands run inside Gemini CLI, by the model or via your own !, get GEMINI_CLI=1, so scripts can tell they're running in Gemini CLI.

zh: 在 GitHub 上把 issue 的 Assignee 选成 Copilot，Copilot cloud agent（以前叫 coding agent）就会自己研究代码、改分支、开 PR。
en: Assign a GitHub issue to Copilot and Copilot cloud agent (formerly coding agent) researches the repo, works on a branch and opens a PR.

zh: Copilot 的项目说明写在 .github/copilot-instructions.md；按路径分的放 .github/instructions/，文件名以 .instructions.md 结尾。
en: Copilot repo instructions live in .github/copilot-instructions.md; path-specific ones go in .github/instructions/ as *.instructions.md.

zh: Copilot 的 .instructions.md 用 applyTo 写 glob 指定文件；加上 excludeAgent: "code-review"，代码审查就跳过它，只给 cloud agent 读。
en: In Copilot *.instructions.md, applyTo sets the glob; add excludeAgent: "code-review" so code review skips it and only cloud agent reads it.

zh: Copilot cloud agent 开工前要装依赖，就写 .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml，job 必须叫 copilot-setup-steps，放默认分支。
en: Preinstall deps for Copilot cloud agent in .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml; the job must be named copilot-setup-steps.

zh: 你回复 Copilot 代码审查的评论，人看得到，Copilot 看不到也不会回。想让它照着改，点评论上的 Fix with Copilot。
en: Replies to Copilot code review comments are seen by humans, not by Copilot, and it won't answer. Click Fix with Copilot to have it act.

zh: Copilot 审 PR 默认只留 Comment，不算批准，也不计入必需审批数。开了审批功能它才会 Approve，之后再推新提交，这个批准就作废。
en: Copilot's PR reviews are plain Comments by default, not approvals. If approvals are enabled, a new push dismisses its approval.

zh: Copilot CLI 里用 /delegate，或在提示前加个 &，把任务丢给云端 cloud agent：它开分支、建草稿 PR，做完请你 review。
en: In Copilot CLI, /delegate or a leading & hands the task to cloud agent: it branches, opens a draft PR, and requests your review when done.

zh: Copilot CLI 的 /rubber-duck 请一只「橡皮鸭」来挑刺，而且特意换家模型审：你用 Claude，它可能派 GPT 当评审。它只读不改。
en: Copilot CLI's /rubber-duck gets a read-only critique from a deliberately different model: Claude session, maybe a GPT critic.

zh: Copilot CLI 的 /fleet 把计划拆成互不依赖的小任务，派多个子 agent 并行跑，每个都有自己的上下文窗口。
en: Copilot CLI's /fleet splits a plan into independent subtasks and runs subagents in parallel, each with its own context window.

zh: Copilot CLI 空输入框里敲一个 $ 再回车，直接切进真正的交互 shell，vim 和 Tab 补全都能用，exit 就回来。
en: In Copilot CLI, type a lone $ and Enter to drop into a real interactive shell (vim, tab completion work); exit to come back.

zh: Aider 每改一次文件就自动 git commit，提交信息末尾挂一行 Co-authored-by: aider，谁写的一目了然。不满意就 /undo 撤掉它最近那次提交。
en: Aider auto-commits every edit with a Co-authored-by: aider trailer. Don't like it? /undo drops its last commit.

zh: Aider 自动提交默认带 --no-verify，会跳过你的 pre-commit 钩子。想让钩子照跑，启动时加 --git-commit-verify。
en: Aider's auto-commits skip your pre-commit hooks by default (--no-verify). Launch with --git-commit-verify to run them.

zh: Aider 的 /architect 让两个模型接力：架构师模型先出方案，编辑模型再把方案落成具体的文件改动。
en: Aider's /architect splits the work between two models: an architect proposes the change, an editor turns it into actual file edits.

zh: Aider 开 --watch-files 后，在代码里写一行以 AI! 结尾的注释，它就照着改；以 AI? 结尾就回答问题。用哪个编辑器写都行。
en: Run Aider with --watch-files, then end a code comment with AI! to have it make the change, or AI? to get an answer. Any editor works.

zh: Aider 每次请求都附一张仓库地图，列出各文件里关键的类和函数签名，模型不读全文也知道代码长啥样。/map 能把它打印出来。
en: Aider sends a repo map with each request: key classes and function signatures per file. /map prints it.

zh: Aider 的更新日志每版都写一句「Aider 写了这版多少代码」，按 git blame 算新增行。v0.86.0 那版是 88%。
en: Aider's changelog reports how much of each release Aider wrote itself, via git blame on new lines. v0.86.0: 88%.

zh: OpenCode 里按 Tab 在 Build 和 Plan 两个主 agent 间切换。Plan 默认改文件、跑命令都得先问你。
en: In OpenCode, Tab switches between the Build and Plan agents. Plan asks before any file edit or bash command by default.

zh: OpenCode 的 /undo 撤回上一条消息，连带它改的文件；/redo 再恢复。背后靠 Git，所以项目得是个 Git 仓库。
en: OpenCode's /undo removes your last message and its file changes; /redo brings them back. It uses Git, so the project must be a repo.

zh: 从 Claude Code 搬到 OpenCode 不用改文件：没有 AGENTS.md 时它会读 CLAUDE.md，也认 ~/.claude/skills。
en: Moving from Claude Code to OpenCode? With no AGENTS.md it falls back to CLAUDE.md, and it reads ~/.claude/skills too.

zh: OpenCode 的 /share 生成的是公开链接，谁拿到都能看对话。在 opencode.json 里把 share 设成 "disabled" 就彻底关掉。
en: OpenCode's /share makes a public link anyone can open. Set "share": "disabled" in opencode.json to turn sharing off entirely.

zh: OpenCode 能直接复用别家的规则：在 opencode.json 的 instructions 里写 .cursor/rules/*.md，甚至填一个远程 URL。
en: OpenCode can reuse existing rules: list .cursor/rules/*.md, or even a remote URL, under instructions in opencode.json.

zh: Moonshot 的老 Kimi CLI（Python 版）已停止维护，新版 Kimi Code CLI 用 Node.js 重写。跑 kimi migrate 能把配置、MCP 和会话一并搬来。
en: The old Python Kimi CLI is no longer maintained; Kimi Code CLI is a Node.js rewrite. kimi migrate brings over config, MCP and sessions.

zh: Kimi Code CLI 内置 /import-from-cc-codex，把 Claude Code 和 Codex 里的指令、skills、MCP 设置一键导进来。
en: Kimi Code CLI ships /import-from-cc-codex to pull in your instructions, skills and MCP settings from Claude Code and Codex.

zh: Kimi Code CLI 的 /undo 只撤回对话里的提示词，连带 todo 和计划状态，但不回滚代码。改坏的文件得自己用 Git 救。
en: Kimi Code CLI's /undo rewinds prompts plus todo and plan state, but not code changes. Use Git to recover broken files.

zh: Kimi Code CLI 里模型还在输出时，打好字按 Ctrl-S，消息会在下一个能打断的时机插进当前这一轮，不用等它说完。
en: In Kimi Code CLI, type while it's streaming and press Ctrl-S to steer: your message lands in the current turn at the next safe point.

zh: Qwen Code 的 /arena 让几个模型同时做同一个任务，各自在独立 git worktree 里跑，做完你对比结果，挑个赢家合并回来。
en: Qwen Code's /arena runs several models on the same task, each in its own git worktree, then lets you compare and merge the winner.

zh: Qwen Code 能接进微信、QQ、钉钉、飞书和 Telegram：在 settings.json 配好 channels，跑 qwen channel start，手机发消息就能指挥它。
en: Qwen Code can live in WeChat, QQ, DingTalk, Feishu or Telegram: set up channels in settings.json and run qwen channel start.

zh: Qwen Code 的 .qwen/QWEN.local.md 放只给自己、只用于本项目的说明，比团队的 QWEN.md 后加载。它不会自动进 .gitignore，得自己加。
en: Qwen Code's .qwen/QWEN.local.md holds personal, per-project notes, loaded after the team QWEN.md. Add it to .gitignore yourself.

zh: Qwen Code 的 Qwen OAuth 免费档已在 2026 年 4 月 15 日停掉。现在要在 /auth 里改用阿里云 Coding Plan、OpenRouter 等服务。
en: Qwen Code's free Qwen OAuth tier ended on April 15, 2026. Use /auth to switch to Alibaba Cloud Coding Plan, OpenRouter or another provider.

zh: 智谱 GLM Coding Plan 的额度有两道闸：5 小时一刷新，外加每周上限。用完只能等刷新，不会去扣你账户余额。
en: Z.ai's GLM Coding Plan has a 5-hour quota plus a weekly cap. Run out and you wait for the reset; it never dips into your account balance.

zh: 用智谱 GLM Coding Plan 接 Claude Code、Codex 或 OpenCode，跑一句 npx @z_ai/coding-helper，向导帮你装工具、配套餐、管 MCP。
en: To plug Z.ai's GLM Coding Plan into Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode, run npx @z_ai/coding-helper; a wizard installs and configures it.

zh: Claude Code 接智谱 GLM：模型名加 [1m]（如 glm-5.3-flash[1m]）开 100 万上下文，再把 CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW 设为 1000000。
en: GLM in Claude Code: add [1m] to the model (glm-5.3-flash[1m]) for 1M context and set CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW to 1000000.

zh: 智谱 GLM Coding Plan 附带 Zread MCP，能搜 GitHub 仓库文档、看目录结构、读源码，研究开源库时不用自己克隆。
en: Z.ai's GLM Coding Plan includes Zread MCP: search a GitHub repo's docs, view its structure and read files without cloning it.

zh: 2026 年 6 月 2 日，Windsurf 改名 Devin Desktop。还是同一个编辑器、价格不变，老的 .windsurfrules 也照样读。
en: On June 2, 2026, Windsurf became Devin Desktop: same editor, same pricing, and it still reads your old .windsurfrules.

zh: Cline 会自动认出 .cursorrules、.windsurfrules 和 AGENTS.md，在 Rules 面板里逐个开关。自家规则放 .clinerules/ 目录。
en: Cline auto-detects .cursorrules, .windsurfrules and AGENTS.md and lets you toggle each in the Rules panel. Its own rules go in .clinerules/.

zh: Zed 里运行 zed: acp registry 打开 ACP 注册表，把 Claude、Codex、OpenCode、Copilot 等 agent 装进 Agent 面板，Zed 不另收费。
en: In Zed, run zed: acp registry to install external agents like Claude, Codex, OpenCode or Copilot. Zed doesn't charge for them.

zh: AGENTS.md 可以嵌套：monorepo 的每个子包各放一份，agent 会读离当前文件最近的那份。官网说 OpenAI 主仓库当时就有 88 个。
en: AGENTS.md nests: put one in each package and agents read the nearest one. The site says OpenAI's main repo had 88 at the time.

zh: 2026 年一篇论文实测：给编程 agent 配上 AGENTS.md 这类文件，成功率基本没提高，推理成本却平均多两成以上。写项目概览尤其没用。
en: A 2026 paper found AGENTS.md-style files barely improve coding agents' success while raising inference cost 20%+. Repo overviews don't help.

zh: GitHub 博客作者分析了 2500 多份 agents.md，最常见又管用的约束是「绝不提交密钥」。边界建议分三档写：总是做、先问我、绝不做。
en: A GitHub Blog study of 2,500+ agents.md files: "Never commit secrets" was the top useful rule. Write limits as always / ask first / never.

zh: 自己写 stdio 的 MCP 服务器，别往 stdout 打印调试信息。规范要求 stdout 只能出现 MCP 消息，日志请写到 stderr。
en: Writing a stdio MCP server? Never print debug output to stdout. The spec allows only MCP messages there; send logs to stderr.

zh: 2026 年 7 月版 MCP 规范去掉了 initialize 握手，协议变成无状态：每个请求都自带协议版本和客户端能力。
en: The July 2026 MCP spec dropped the initialize handshake. MCP is now stateless: every request carries its protocol version and capabilities.

zh: 调试 MCP 服务器不必接 AI：npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector 打开网页版检查器，加 --cli 还能在 CI 里直接调 tools/list。
en: Debug an MCP server without any AI: npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector opens a web inspector; add --cli to call tools/list from CI.

zh: 本地跑 HTTP 的 MCP 服务器，要只绑 127.0.0.1 别绑 0.0.0.0，还必须校验 Origin 头，否则恶意网页能借 DNS 重绑定调用它。
en: A local HTTP MCP server should bind 127.0.0.1, not 0.0.0.0, and check the Origin header, or web pages can reach it via DNS rebinding.

zh: 工具投毒：Invariant Labs 演示过，恶意 MCP 的 add 工具在描述里藏指令，让模型读 ~/.ssh/id_rsa，塞进叫 sidenote 的参数带走。
en: Tool poisoning: Invariant Labs showed an MCP add tool whose description told the model to read ~/.ssh/id_rsa and pass it as a sidenote.

zh: GitGuardian 发现，MCP 文档常教人把密钥直接写进配置文件。他们研究的 MCP 配置文件里，泄露的密钥有 24008 个。
en: GitGuardian: MCP docs often say to paste credentials into config files. It found 24,008 unique secrets in the MCP configs it studied.

zh: 很多语言序列化 JSON 不保证键的顺序。agent 每轮把数据转成 JSON 时顺序一变，前缀就不同了，提示缓存悄悄失效。
en: Many JSON serializers don't keep key order. If an agent's JSON is reordered between turns, the prefix changes and the cache quietly misses.

zh: Manus 的建议：把 agent 犯的错留在上下文里，别清掉重试。看到失败的操作和报错，模型下次就不太会重蹈覆辙。
en: Manus's advice: leave the agent's mistakes in context instead of wiping and retrying. Seeing the failure and error steers it away next time.

zh: 自己写压缩提示词？Anthropic 建议先追求召回，确保该留的都留住，再慢慢删冗余。最省事的一步是清掉早已用过的工具结果。
en: Writing a compaction prompt? Anthropic says maximize recall first, then trim for precision. The lightest step: clear old tool results.

zh: Cognition 讲过个反例：两个子 agent 分头做 Flappy Bird，一个把背景做成了超级马里奥，另一个做的鸟画风对不上。它们看不到彼此的决定。
en: Cognition's cautionary tale: two subagents split a Flappy Bird clone. One built a Super Mario background; neither saw the other's choices.

zh: OpenAI 从 GPT-5.6 起，缓存写入按输入价 1.25 倍收，读取 0.1 倍，GPT-6.1 Sol 只要 0.05 倍。写一次读九次，总价约为不缓存的五分之一。
en: From GPT-5.6, OpenAI bills cache writes at 1.25x input, reads at 0.1x (0.05x on GPT-6.1 Sol). One write, nine reads: about 1/5 the cost.

zh: OpenAI 建议：想临时禁用工具，把 tool_choice 设成 none；只开部分工具用 allowed_tools。别删工具定义，一改缓存前缀就废了。
en: OpenAI's advice: to disable tools for a turn, set tool_choice to none, or use allowed_tools. Deleting definitions breaks the cached prefix.

zh: 提示缓存也能被用来刺探：攻击者提交猜测的提示，看命不命中缓存，就能推出别人发过什么。OpenAI 建议每个客户用不同的 prompt_cache_key。
en: Prompt caches can leak: an attacker submits guesses and watches for cache hits. OpenAI suggests a separate prompt_cache_key per customer.

zh: DeepSeek 的缓存存在硬盘上，默认开着。第一次发 A+B、第二次发 A+C 不会命中，但系统发现公共前缀 A 后会存下来，第三次 A+D 就命中了。
en: DeepSeek caches on disk, on by default. A+B then A+C misses, but it then saves the shared prefix A, so a third request A+D hits.

zh: Claude API 上，提示短于最低长度（现役模型多为 512 token）时，标了 cache_control 也不缓存，还不报错。两个缓存字段都为 0 就是它。
en: On the Claude API, prompts below the minimum (512 tokens on current models) silently skip caching. Both cache usage fields at 0 is the tell.

zh: 给自己的 agent 做评测不用等攒够几百题。Anthropic 说，从真实翻车里挑 20 到 50 个简单任务，就是很好的开始。
en: You don't need hundreds of tasks to eval your agent. Anthropic says 20 to 50 simple tasks drawn from real failures is a great start.

zh: Anthropic 说，前沿模型跑 100 次全挂（pass@100 为 0），多半不是模型不行，而是题目或判分器坏了。先回去检查题目描述。
en: Anthropic: if a frontier model fails a task 100 times out of 100, the task or grader is usually broken. Recheck the spec first.

zh: 评测每次都要从干净环境开始。Anthropic 发现，Claude 在内部评测里会去翻前几次试跑留下的 git 历史，白白占了便宜。
en: Start every eval trial from a clean environment. Anthropic caught Claude reading git history left by earlier trials for an unfair edge.

zh: METR 曾发现自家题目有坑：题面说达到某分数线就行，判分却要求超过。结果老实照做的模型反而吃亏，无视目标的分更高。
en: METR found tasks saying "reach this score" but grading "exceed it". Models that obeyed lost points; ones ignoring the goal scored higher.

zh: METR 的「时间跨度」说的是题目难度（人类专家要做多久），不是 AI 能自己跑多久。完成同样的任务，AI 通常比人快好几倍。
en: METR's time horizon is task difficulty in human-expert time, not how long an AI runs alone. AIs often do such tasks several times faster.

zh: Meta 的「智能体二选规则」：处理不可信输入、碰敏感系统或私密数据、改动状态或对外通信，一次会话里这三项最多只占两项。
en: Meta's Agents Rule of Two: per session, at most two of: untrusted input; sensitive data or systems; changing state or talking externally.

zh: 防提示注入的 map-reduce 模式：每份不可信文件交给一个子 agent，它只许回答是或否，比如「这是不是本月发票」。注入的话传不出来。
en: Map-reduce defense: each untrusted file goes to a sub-agent that may only answer yes or no, so injected text has no way out.

zh: Simon Willison 不信那些号称能拦 95% 提示注入的「护栏」产品：在 Web 安全里，95% 是不及格。
en: Simon Willison distrusts guardrail products claiming to stop 95% of prompt injections: in web security, 95% is a failing grade.

zh: 给 agent 的凭证要能限住损失。Simon 为让 AI 调 Fly.io 部署，专门建了个组织、设 5 美元预算，再发一个只能管这个组织的 API key。
en: Scope agent credentials. To let AI deploy on Fly.io, Simon made a dedicated org with a $5 budget and an API key limited to that org.

zh: Simon Willison 2026 年 10 月呼吁：按量付费的服务都该默认带硬性预算上限，超了就停。agent 搭的服务半夜跑飞，提醒邮件救不了你。
en: Simon Willison (Oct 2026): pay-per-use services need default hard budget caps. If an agent-built app runs wild overnight, alerts won't help.

zh: 对 agent 说一句「Use red/green TDD」就够了：先写测试并亲眼看它失败，再写实现让它变绿。好模型都懂这个缩写。
en: Just tell the agent "use red/green TDD": write tests, watch them fail, then make them pass. Every good model knows the shorthand.

zh: Simon Willison 每次在老项目开新会话，第一句都是「First run the tests」。agent 知道了有测试、大概多少条，之后改完自然会去跑。
en: Simon Willison starts each session on an existing project with "First run the tests". The agent learns the suite exists and keeps using it.

zh: git bisect 好用但写判定脚本麻烦，这活正好丢给 agent：「用 git bisect 找出这个 bug 是哪次提交引入的」。
en: git bisect is powerful but fiddly to script. Hand it to the agent: "Use git bisect to find when this bug was introduced."

zh: 让 agent 讲解代码时，叫它用 sed、grep、cat 把代码片段直接贴进文档，而不是自己抄一遍。手抄的片段可能被编错。
en: For a code walkthrough, have the agent pull snippets in with sed, grep or cat instead of retyping them, which risks hallucinated code.

zh: 把提交当游戏存档：每做完一小步、测试通过就提交一次。别攒成一个叫「AI changes」的大提交，出了问题都不知道是哪步坏的。
en: Treat commits as save points: commit after each small step passes tests. One giant "AI changes" commit hides which step broke things.

zh: 别把自己都没看过的 AI 代码直接丢给同事审。Simon 的说法：那等于把真正的活推给别人。agent 写的 PR 描述，你也得先读一遍。
en: Don't file PRs of agent code you haven't reviewed. Simon: that's handing the real work to others. Read the agent's PR description too.

zh: Simon Willison 想让 agent 用他的 shot-scraper 截图，只在 AGENTS.md 里放了一条完整示例命令。agent 自己就会换网址和文件名照着用。
en: Simon Willison put one full shot-scraper example command in AGENTS.md. That alone let the agent swap URLs and filenames for new screenshots.

zh: MCP 工具注解只是提示：readOnlyHint 默认 false，destructiveHint 默认 true。规范说不可信服务器给的注解，客户端别拿来做决定。
en: MCP tool annotations are hints: readOnlyHint defaults to false, destructiveHint to true. Ignore annotations from untrusted servers.

zh: MCP 的「卷款跑路」：服务器先给你看无害的工具描述，等你批准之后再悄悄改掉。安装时审过，不等于以后都安全。
en: MCP rug pull: a server shows a harmless tool description, then quietly changes it after you approve. Vetted at install isn't safe forever.

zh: Manus 做复杂任务会建个 todo.md 边做边勾。这不是卖萌：一个任务平均约 50 次工具调用，反复重写清单等于把目标念到上下文末尾。
en: Manus keeps a todo.md and ticks items off. Not just cute: over ~50 tool calls, rewriting it recites the goals at the end of context.

zh: OpenAI 上对话中途改 reasoning.effort 会破坏缓存。GPT-6 系列可以往 input 追加一个 configuration_update 换思考力度，前缀不动。
en: On OpenAI, changing reasoning.effort mid-chat can break the cache. On GPT-6 models, append a configuration_update input item instead.

zh: Claude API 的缓存查找每个断点只往回看 20 个内容块。一轮新增 20 块或更多，上次写的缓存就找不到了，得提前在中间多加一个断点。
en: Claude API cache lookup checks only 20 blocks back per breakpoint. Add 20+ blocks in a turn and it misses; add a second breakpoint early.

zh: 给 agent 判分，看结果别看路径。Anthropic 发现规定必须按某个顺序调工具，测试会很脆，还会惩罚它想出的你没料到的好办法。
en: Grade what the agent produced, not its path. Anthropic found fixed tool-call orders make brittle tests that punish valid new approaches.

zh: Simon Willison 提醒：偷数据不一定要调 API。工具只要能加载一张图片，甚至只是给你一个链接去点，就能把机密拼进 URL 发给攻击者。
en: Simon Willison: stealing data needn't use an API. A tool that loads an image, or just shows a link to click, can leak secrets in a URL.

zh: Simon Willison 开新会话常先说一句「Review changes made today」，agent 会去跑 git log，把你最近改了什么一口气装进上下文。
en: Simon Willison starts fresh sessions with "Review changes made today": the agent runs git log and loads your recent work into context.
